raw.description:
Join the VRChat Team!

VRChat offers a first-of-its-kind, game-changing platform that provides an endless collection of social VR experiences and gives the power of creation to its robust community. With over 250,000 worlds and growing, VRChat’s vision is to allow users to bring their imaginations to life and help shape the metaverse anywhere in the world on any device. VRChat has raised $100M to date with the support of investors, Makers Fund, Anthos Capital and HTC.
We have a great team which includes people from: Netflix, Twitter, Meta, Microsoft, Roblox, Google, Amazon, Unity, Spotify, Discord, Uber, eBay, Robinhood, Twitch, Zynga and TikTok. Come and join the mission!

Job Overview

We’re looking for a data / ML engineer to join our Social Experience team. You will be instrumental in developing and refining the data-driven recommendations systems that help our users connect, interact, and discover content and communities. This role involves working with AWS, Python/FastAPI, Node.js, and Snowflake to build, train, and operationalize personalization systems. You will be instrumental in processing and transforming the large volumes of data generated by our platform to create meaningful user experiences. If you’re passionate about data engineering and leveraging data to enhance content discovery, this role could be the perfect fit.

What You'll Do

  • Work within a full-stack team of engineers to develop, maintain, and optimize scalable data pipelines, backend services, and APIs for data-driven features like recommendations, content discovery, groups, and events in VRChat.
  • Design and implement data models and schemas that support both analytical needs and real-time recommendation systems.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, product managers, and other engineers to ensure the correct data is captured, processed, and available to power meaningful user experiences.
  • Implement and maintain data processing jobs using big data technologies (e.g., Spark, Kafka) to handle large-scale datasets.
  • Contribute to the evolution of our technical and product capabilities, helping to progress from simple heuristics to more sophisticated, data-backed personalization for content and experiences.
  • Participate in the design and implementation of backend systems including REST and websocket APIs, caching systems, queueing systems, and cloud orchestration.
  • Be available to occasionally jump into action to solve an outage.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in software engineering, with a strong focus on data engineering and building scalable backend systems for SaaS products or online platforms.
  • Proven experience building and optimizing production-grade data pipelines (ETL/ELT).Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with database optimization for both analytical queries and high-throughput real-time access.
  • Experience with big data technologies such as Spark, Hadoop/Beam, or Kafka.
  • Experience with cloud providers at scale, such as AWS or Google Cloud.
  • Able to work in a variety of languages and technologies, such as Python, JavaScript/Node.js, Mongo, and Redis.
  • Experience with Elasticsearch, data warehousing, and machine learning (ML) systems.
  • An agile, collaborative mindset and excellent communication skills, capable of working effectively in a remote, cross-functional team environment.

Bonus Points

  • Experience building and scaling aspects of content discovery or recommendation systems.
  • Demonstrated interest in online communities, VR, or VRChat (as a user or creator). Knowing how our platform and community works will be helpful for this role.
  • Experience with social networks, social graphs, or systems dealing with user-generated content.
  • Experience working on consumer products, e-commerce, or two-sided marketplaces.

Benefits

  • Work from anywhere! VRChat is a 100% remote company offering flexible working hours in combination with core hours supporting real-time collaboration
  • Health Benefits
  • 401K for US & Group RRSP for Canadian Employees
  • Stock Options
  • Generous paid holiday schedule
  • Unlimited/flexible vacation time
  • Paid parental leave benefits
VRChat is an equal-opportunity employer, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds. VRChat fosters a diverse, creative, and collaborative environment where anyone can contribute to any of the ongoing projects or direction of the roadmap at any time. If you’re a passionate team player who wants to have an impact on a dynamic team, we’d love to hear from you!
All job offers are subject to satisfactory referencing and background checks.

raw.description:
Opal Group organizes premier virtual and live conferences catered to top executives and decision-makers throughout various industries. We are dedicated to providing high-quality events and information through unparalleled speaking sessions, workshops, and unique face-to-face networking opportunities. Our unique work environment offers an opportunity for the "self-starter" with unlimited growth potential.

The Webmaster & Digital Marketing role is responsible for managing the day-to-day administration, technical performance, search visibility, analytics, and digital marketing effectiveness of Opal Group’s websites and related marketing platforms.
This is a hands-on role that combines website management, SEO, analytics, marketing technology, social media, and digital campaign execution. The primary objective is to improve website reliability, traffic, user engagement, lead generation, event registrations, campaign performance, and data visibility across the organization.

Job Type: FT International Consultant
Compensation Range: $1,500 - $1,800 USD per month
Location: Remote
Important: Only ENGLISH resumes and cover letters will be considered.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

  • Website Management & Performance:
    • Manage the day-to-day administration of company websites and content management systems
    • Create and update event pages, landing pages, speaker and sponsor information, forms, navigation, redirects, images, documents, and other website content
    • Monitor website uptime, speed, mobile responsiveness, Core Web Vitals, broken links, crawl errors, and technical performance
    • Troubleshoot website, form, display, tracking, and integration issues
    • Manage or coordinate website hosting, domains, DNS, SSL certificates, backups, staging environments, plugins, themes, security updates, and user permissions
    • Perform website quality assurance across major devices and browsers
    • Make basic website changes using HTML and CSS and coordinate advanced development work when required
    • Support website accessibility, privacy, cookie-consent, and security requirements
    • Monitor and manage website crawling and indexing through Google Search Console, including XML sitemaps, URL inspection, robots.txt directives, canonical tags, redirects, crawl errors, and excluded or duplicate pages
    • Diagnose and resolve technical issues that prevent website pages from being discovered, crawled, indexed, or properly displayed in search results
    • Manage Google AdSense implementation, account configuration, ad placements, policy compliance, performance monitoring, and troubleshooting where applicable
  • SEO & Digital Growth:
    • Execute technical and on-page SEO initiatives, including keyword research, metadata, headings, internal linking, structured data, image optimization, sitemaps, redirects, and indexing
    • Monitor organic traffic, search rankings, crawl activity, search visibility, and indexing performance
    • Work with Marketing teams to optimize event and company content for search visibility and user engagement
    • Identify opportunities to improve landing pages, forms, calls to action, registration paths, and conversion rates
    • Conduct tests and recommend website improvements based on analytics, user behavior, and campaign results
  • Social Media & Digital Campaigns:
    • Manage the social media content calendar and coordinate the drafting, scheduling, and publishing of company and event-related content
    • Support organic and paid social media campaigns, audience targeting, tracking, testing, and reporting
    • Coordinate campaign graphics, videos, copy, links, and related materials with internal or external resources
    • Monitor social engagement, referral traffic, campaign conversions, comments, messages, and brand activity
    • Build and support coordinated digital campaigns across websites, social media, email, CRM, and marketing automation platforms
    • Implement campaign tracking using UTMs, conversion events, pixels, and standardized naming conventions
  • Analytics & Marketing Technology:
    • Configure and maintain website analytics, tag management, conversion tracking, search-performance, and reporting platforms
    • Develop dashboards and reports covering website traffic, SEO, user behavior, lead generation, registration activity, social media, and campaign effectiveness
    • Analyze data, identify trends, and provide actionable recommendations to improve digital performance
    • Administer and support marketing technology tools, CRM integrations, marketing automation, forms, tracking systems, and related workflows
    • Monitor data quality and ensure the accuracy and consistency of marketing performance metrics
    • Document processes, platform configurations, tracking standards, workflows, and system requirements
    • Coordinate website and marketing technology projects from planning through implementation
    • Manage relationships with website, hosting, marketing, and technology vendors as needed
    • Configure, maintain, and optimize Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, and related tracking tools
    • Establish and maintain GA4 events, conversions, audiences, campaign tracking, and reporting for website forms, event registrations, downloads, inquiries, and other important user actions
    • Validate analytics and advertising tags to ensure data is collected accurately across websites, landing pages, forms, and registration paths
    • Develop Google Analytics dashboards and reports covering traffic sources, user behavior, conversions, engagement, campaign performance, and website trends
    • Monitor Google AdSense metrics, including impressions, click-through rates, page revenue, ad performance, and policy notifications

Requirements:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in website administration, digital marketing, SEO, analytics, marketing technology, or a related role
  • Hands-on experience administering WordPress or a comparable content management system
  • Experience creating and maintaining website pages, landing pages, forms, navigation, redirects, and digital content
  • Working knowledge of HTML and CSS; basic JavaScript knowledge is preferred
  • Experience with website analytics, tag management, search-performance, dashboard, and reporting platforms
  • Strong understanding of technical SEO, on-page SEO, website optimization, user experience, and conversion principles
  • Experience managing business social media accounts, publishing calendars, campaign tracking, and performance reporting
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, marketing automation, and website integrations
  • Proficiency in Excel and data-visualization or dashboard tools
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable recommendations
  • Advanced English skills in verbal and written communication are required
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and assignments in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, documentation, and follow-through
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently while collaborating effectively with Marketing, Technology, Sales, and Operations teams
  • Hands-on experience with Google Analytics 4, including event tracking, conversion configuration, traffic-source analysis, user-behavior reporting, and dashboard development
  • Experience with Google Search Console, website crawling, XML sitemaps, indexing, URL inspection, robots.txt, canonicalization, redirects, and troubleshooting search-coverage issues
  • Experience implementing and validating website tracking through Google Tag Manager
  • Experience configuring, managing, or supporting Google AdSense, including ad placement, reporting, troubleshooting, and policy compliance
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Information Technology, Digital Media, Data Analytics, Business, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience
  • Experience with website hosting, DNS, SSL certificates, backups, security, and staging environments
  • Experience managing paid social media or paid search campaigns
  • Experience with event marketing, conference websites, registration systems, or lead-generation campaigns
  • Familiarity with accessibility, privacy, cookie-consent, and digital security practices
  • Basic graphic-editing or design-platform experience
  • Portfolio or work samples demonstrating relevant experience with website management, SEO, analytics, social media, or digital marketing campaigns are preferred
Benefits & Work Environment:
At Opal Group, we value our team members and offer a comprehensive and supportive work culture. Our benefits include:
  • 100% remote work environment with occasional travel to on-site conferences (based on position)
  • Paid Time Off (available after 90 days), including:
    • Vacation Days

    • One Wellness & Wellbeing Day, One Floating Holiday, and One Religious Observance Day per year
  • Paid federal holidays with early release the day prior
  • Summer Fridays
  • All travel-related expenses covered for onsite events, including flights, hotel accommodations, and meals
Join a company that values innovation, initiative, and the individuals who drive it forward!

raw.excerpt: intro Du suchst mehr als nur den nächsten Auftrag und willst, dass deine Texte tatsächlich etwas bewegen?
raw.description:
intro

Du suchst mehr als nur den nächsten Auftrag und willst, dass deine Texte tatsächlich etwas bewegen?

Bei uns erreichst du tausende Führungskräfte aus dem C-Level mit wertvollen Inhalten aus erster Hand. Du lieferst ihnen Impulse, die Entscheidungen, Teams und Unternehmen prägen.

Ausbilden müssen wir dich dafür nicht, denn du lieferst ab Tag eins eigenständig, verlässlich und mit Gespür dafür, was bei einer anspruchsvollen Zielgruppe ankommt.

Vergütung, Umfang und Start

Wir suchen jemanden, der sofort starten kann, spätestens innerhalb der nächsten 4 bis 6 Wochen.

Es handelt sich um eine freiberufliche Zusammenarbeit auf Stundenbasis. Der Stundensatz liegt je nach Erfahrung und Portfolio bei 20 bis 30 Euro.

  • Wir bieten dir einen Retainer von 40 Stunden pro Monat. Diese Stunden garantieren wir dir und vergüten sie unabhängig vom tatsächlichen Aufkommen.

  • Du solltest mindestens 10 Stunden pro Woche verlässlich für uns einplanen können.

  • In intensiven Phasen liegt der Bedarf höher, teilweise bei 60 Stunden im Monat. Alles über den Retainer hinaus rechnen wir nach Aufwand ab. Die Flexibilität, in solchen Phasen hochzufahren, ist uns wichtig.

  • Der Umfang variiert je nach Projektlage und Saison.

Über SAWOO

Die SAWOO GmbH ist ein internationales, dynamisches Unternehmen mit Sitz in Deutschland und rund 25 Mitarbeitenden. Wir bauen und betreiben Communities, die Führungskräfte aus dem C-Level großer Unternehmen zusammenbringen. Unser Ziel ist es, diesen Leader:innen dabei zu helfen, Herausforderungen zu lösen und persönlich wie beruflich zu wachsen. Zu unseren Mitgliedern zählen Führungskräfte von Mercedes-Benz, Porsche, Airbus, Amazon und Siemens.

In unseren Communities organisieren wir aktuell:

  • rund 25 Networking-Events in 7 Ländern pro Monat

  • 4 Konferenzen pro Jahr in München, London und Paris

  • laufenden digitalen Content auf LinkedIn, per E-Mail und über WhatsApp

Bis 2034 wollen wir zwei Millionen aktive Mitglieder in unseren Communities begrüßen. Schau dir “LEADERS IN CONSULTING” und “Level Up HR” Communities als Beispiele an.

your tasks

Deine Aufgaben

Warum es diese Rolle gibt

Deine Texte prägen, wie Top-Führungskräfte in unseren deutschsprachigen Communities lernen, sich vernetzen und mit uns interagieren. Die Rolle existiert aus zwei Gründen.

  • Relevante Impulse liefern: Du schreibst Content, der deutschsprachigen Entscheider:innen in großen Organisationen Klarheit, Inspiration und echten Mehrwert gibt.

  • Neue Mitglieder gewinnen: Dein Content sorgt dafür, dass Führungskräfte uns entdecken, den Wert unserer Arbeit verstehen und aktive Community-Mitglieder werden.

Qualität, Konsistenz und Reichweite deiner Texte wirken direkt auf unsere Glaubwürdigkeit und unser Wachstum im DACH-Raum.

Woran wir Erfolg messen

  • Dein Content erzeugt relevante Interaktionen unserer Zielpersonen auf LinkedIn und im Newsletter

  • Deliverables kommen pünktlich und brauchen keine bis wenige Korrekturschleifen

  • Du wirst über die Zeit besser: stärkere Hooks, höheres Engagement, sauberere Formatierung

  • Du verstehst die Zielgruppe und schreibst für Entscheider:innen, nicht für Algorithmen

Womit du arbeitest

Du betreust mehrere deutschsprachige Communities parallel. Jede Community hat einen eigenen Host, eine eigene Tonalität und eigene Regeln. Zwischen diesen Kontexten sicher zu wechseln, gehört zum Job.

Deine Inhalte entstehen überwiegend aus vorhandenem Material: Podcast-Aufnahmen, Interview-Transkripte und Event-Insights.

Schreiben

  • LinkedIn-Posts, die die Aufmerksamkeit von Senior Professionals gewinnen

  • LinkedIn-Newsletter und E-Mail-Newsletter, inhaltlich stark und klar strukturiert

  • Deep-Dive-Artikel und Case Studies auf Basis von Expert:innen-Interviews

  • Show Notes, Episodentitel und Episodenbeschreibungen

  • Interview-Leitfäden inklusive Agenda und Kernfragen

  • Follow-up-Posts zu unseren Events, pro Stadt und Community

  • Kurzformate für WhatsApp

  • Sonderformate wie Playbooks

Mit KI arbeiten

  • KI ist bei uns kein Extra, sondern Teil des Handwerks. Du setzt Claude oder ChatGPT aktiv ein: für Recherche, Rohfassungen, Strukturierung und die Aufbereitung von Transkripten

  • Wir haben dafür eine eigene Prompt-Datenbank, und was funktioniert, teilen wir im Team

  • Die Qualitätsschwelle liegt bei dir. KI-Output geht bei uns nicht ungeprüft raus

Abstimmen

  • Für einzelne Deliverables stehst du direkt mit unseren Kunden in Kontakt. Der Anteil ist überschaubar, aber du solltest dich in dieser Kommunikation sicher bewegen.

  • Du holst Feedback, notwendige Infos und Freigaben selbstständig ein und arbeitest sie gewissenhaft ein.

  • Du stimmst dich mit dem Content Coordinator und dem Content Team ab.

Umsetzen und veröffentlichen

  • Du erstellst ansprechende und hochwertige Inhalte gemäß den Vorgaben.

  • Du veröffentlichst deine Inhalte selbst über unsere Tools und terminierst sie.

  • Du behältst die Performance deiner Inhalte im Blick und trägst aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung unserer Strategie bei.

your profile

Sprache

Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau ist die zwingende Voraussetzung, das ist der Kern der Rolle. Unser Team arbeitet über acht Nationalitäten hinweg, interne Kommunikation und ein Teil unserer Prozessdokumentation laufen auf Englisch. Du solltest dich darin sicher bewegen, mindestens auf B2-Niveau, besser C1.

Erfahrung

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung als Copywriter:in oder Content Writer:in, idealerweise im B2B- oder Digital-Media-Umfeld

  • Ein aussagekräftiges Portfolio mit deutschsprachigen Texten über mehrere Formate hinweg (LinkedIn-Posts, Newsletter, Longform) ist Pflicht

  • Erfahrung im Schreiben für ein professionelles oder Executive-Publikum ist ein deutlicher Pluspunkt

  • Grundwissen in On-Page-SEO für unsere Blogartikel ist von Vorteil

Skills und Tools

  • Du nutzt GenAI-Tools, um effizienter zu arbeiten, ohne dass die Qualität leidet

  • Du erkennst, wo ein Text nach KI klingt, und ziehst ihn glatt. Formulierungsmuster, unsaubere Zeilenumbrüche und generische Floskeln fallen dir auf, bevor sie uns auffallen

  • Erfahrung mit Claude oder ChatGPT, Google Workspace, ClickUp, Canva, Slack und einem CMS wie Sanity ist ein Plus

  • Du formatierst sauber und lieferst Texte, die ohne Nacharbeit veröffentlicht werden können

Wie du arbeitest

  • Verlässlich, strukturiert, proaktiv. Du lieferst, ohne dass wir hinterherlaufen müssen.

  • Du kannst eigenständig mit Community-Hosts kommunizieren und deine Deadlines selbst managen.

  • Du arbeitest mit Regelwerken. Wir haben klare Vorgaben zu CTAs, Verlinkungen, Taggings und Sprachlogik pro Community. Du wendest sie konsequent an, nicht nur beim ersten Mal.

  • Starkes Gespür für Tonalität und Zielgruppe. Für einen CFO schreibst du anders als für ein allgemeines Publikum.

  • Detailgenau, ohne langsam zu werden.

  • Offen für Feedback und darauf aus, dich weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Du bist auf LinkedIn zu Hause und weißt, was dort Engagement erzeugt.

Wann wir vermutlich nicht zusammenpassen

Wir sind lieber vorher ehrlich. Diese Rolle ist eher nichts für dich, wenn:

  • du für jeden Text ein ausführliches Briefing brauchst

  • du ungern mit festen Vorgaben zu Tonalität, Verlinkung und Kanälen arbeitest

  • du KI entweder grundsätzlich ablehnst oder ihre Ergebnisse ungeprüft übernimmst

  • Deadlines bei dir eher Richtwerte sind

  • du (noch) keine deutschsprachigen Textbeispiele zeigen kannst

benefits

  • KI-Kompetenz, die dich weiterbringt: KI ist bei uns fester Teil des Content-Prozesses, kein Experiment nebenbei. Du lernst, sie so einzusetzen, dass deine Arbeit schneller und besser wird: Prompts, Workflows und das Gespür dafür, wo sie nichts verloren hat. Wir teilen offen, was bei uns funktioniert. Kaum ein Skill ist im Copywriting gerade mehr wert.

  • Steile Lernkurve und echte Einblicke: Du siehst von innen, wie ein international aufgestelltes Scale-up arbeitet, und schreibst für und über Führungskräfte großer Unternehmen.

  • Unternehmerische Kultur: Wir fördern Eigenverantwortung auf jeder Ebene. Wer Initiative zeigt, hat den Freiraum, Dinge voranzutreiben.

  • Vollständig remote: Arbeite von dort, wo du bist. Wir sind rund 20 Menschen aus 8 Nationen, verteilt über Deutschland, Südafrika, Spanien, Portugal und den Kosovo.

  • Flache Hierarchien und echte Zusammenarbeit: Wir setzen in allen Rollen auf A-Player, die sich gegenseitig unterstützen. Und wir vergessen bei unseren regelmäßigen Team-Gatherings nicht den Spaß.

outro

Mehr darüber, wer wir sind und wie wir arbeiten, findest du auf unserer Website. Such einfach nach SAWOO GmbH.

Passen wir zusammen?

Dann schick uns deine Bewerbung auf Deutsch, mit:

  • Lebenslauf

  • kurzem Anschreiben

  • Schreibportfolio mit deutschsprachigen Beispielen aus mindestens zwei Formaten (zum Beispiel LinkedIn-Posts, Newsletter oder Longform)

  • deiner Stundensatz-Vorstellung und deiner verfügbaren Kapazität pro Woche

Bewerbungen ohne Anschreiben und Portfolio können wir nicht berücksichtigen. Kandidat:innen in der engeren Auswahl laden wir zu einem kurzen Schreibtest ein.

Wir freuen uns auf dich!

raw.description:
The SAP FI/CO Professional will play a key role in supporting the Körber OneFinance transformation program. This role combines hands‑on SAP S/4HANA expertise with strong process knowledge across Finance, Controlling, and integrated logistics and sales processes. The ideal candidate brings practical experience in SAP FI/CO within S/4HANA environments, an excellent understanding of core accounting processes, and the ability to provide expert support throughout the rollout and post–go‑live stabilization.

Acting as a backfill within the project organization, this position ensures operational continuity while contributing to the successful deployment of S/4HANA across the Körber Group.

Your role in our team

S/4HANA Implementation & Support

  • You provide hands‑on expertise in SAP FI/CO during the S/4HANA rollout, supporting fit‑gap analyses, testing activities, data validation, and cutover preparation
  • You ensure that financial processes in the new system reflect business requirements and adhere to internal and external compliance standards
  • You take ownership of post–go‑live support, including resolving incidents, optimizing processes, and stabilizing the financial landscape after deployment

Process Expertise Across Finance & Logistics

  • You bring deep knowledge of end‑to‑end accounting processes such as Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, General Ledger, Asset Accounting, and Financial Closing
  • You support controlling‑related processes (e.g., cost center accounting, internal orders, basic profitability analysis) and collaborate with CO experts as needed
  • You understand key touchpoints between Finance and logistics processes (FI/MM integration for procurement, FI/SD/CO integration for order‑to‑cash) and help ensure seamless E2E process flows

Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • As an interface between Finance, IT, and business stakeholders, you ensure clear communication and alignment during design, testing, and rollout
  • You support business users with training, documentation, and day‑to‑day issue resolution
  • You collaborate with workstreams to address process dependencies and coordinate integrations across modules (MM, SD, CO)

Operational Backfill & Business Continuity

  • You temporarily take over operational FI/CO tasks to free up internal experts for project activities
  • You ensure stable daily operations throughout the S/4HANA transformation
  • You help identify opportunities for process simplification, automation, or harmonization under the OneFinance/GBS framework

Your profile

  • You hold a degree in Business Administration, Finance, Business Informatics, or a comparable field of study
  • You bring hands‑on experience in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO, ideally from project or transformational environments
  • You have strong expertise in Finance processes (AP, AR, GL, Assets, closing) and good general knowledge of Controlling processes.
  • You understand integrated logistics flows, ideally with experience in FI/MM and SD/FI/CO integration
  • You are comfortable working in dynamic environments and managing multiple priorities during rollout phases
  • With strong communication skills and cultural awareness, you collaborate effectively in international, cross‑functional teams
  • You are fluent in English and German
  • You bring an analytical, solution‑oriented mindset and enjoy working hands‑on with systems and data
  • You are flexible with occasional business travel
  • Experience in global or matrix organizations and familiarity with shared services (GBS) is beneficial

Your benefits

  • Diverse opportunities to help shape the role and extensive options for training and development
  • Flexible working hours and flat hierarchies in an international, modern work environment
  • Mobile working within Germany as well as remote work abroad
  • A work environment with room for initiative and clear ownership of your own topics and projects
  • EGYM Wellpass and supplementary company health insurance to support personal well‑being
  • An Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering confidential advice and support for health-related, professional, and personal challenges
  • Company pension schemes to provide long‑term security
  • Employer subsidy for the Deutschlandticket
  • Monthly attractive employee offers through a leading discount portal
  • IT leasing through salary conversion enables access to modern devices at attractive conditions – including for private use

Your working environment

As a groupwide shared service organization, Körber Global Business Services GmbH consolidates central functions in the areas of HR, IT, and Finance. We support the companies of the Körber Group with efficient processes and standardized service offerings, thereby making a significant contribution to the success of the international Group.

Apply now and join our team!

Ready for your next step? Click on ‘Apply now’ to get started right away! As long as the position is advertised, you can apply at any time.

We value diversity and therefore welcome all applicants - regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic or social origin, religion/belief, disability, age, sexual orientation and identity, and any other protected status. You can find out more about our culture here Culture at Körber - it's worth taking a look!

If you have any questions or technical problems, please send us an e-mail to. Nele Kunkel is the responsible person for this job advertisement. We work with permanent partners and therefore ask recruitment consultants to refrain from contacting us by e-mail or telephone.

Become a part of our caring community

This is a remote position working with members who speak English and also members who speak Spanish. You must be fluent in both English and Spanish for this position. PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR RESUME IN ENGLISH

As a Bilingual Care Management Support Assistant, you will help members take the next step toward better health and well-being. You will do this by connecting with them over the phone, completing important non-clinical assessments, identifying barriers to care, and helping them access resources and benefits. We are looking for people who show compassion and document customer issues in detail, can work in a call center environment, and motivate themselves through work that directly supports members and care teams.

The assigned shift will be 11:30 AM–8:00 PM Eastern Standard Time

What You Will Do

  • Engage members by phone to encourage participation in care management programs.
  • Complete required assessments and questionnaires to help identify health risks, care needs, and opportunities for clinical team follow-up.
  • Assist members who need support scheduling doctor’s appointments or connecting with appropriate care resources.
  • Identify and help address barriers to preventive screenings, benefits, and health-related services so members can close gaps in care.
  • Support members in understanding, retaining, and accessing benefits that contribute to their overall health and well-being.
  • Manage both inbound and outbound calls in an auto-dialer environment while documenting member information.

What Success Looks Like

  • You create a positive member experience by treating each interaction with respect, patience, and professionalism
  • You demonstrate compassion, integrity, and sound judgment when supporting members with sensitive health-related needs
  • You listen to understand member needs, ask appropriate follow-up questions, and solve problems within established guidelines
  • You stay up to date with department guidelines and apply training, tools, and procedures in your daily work
  • You work independently, manage your time, and ask for guidance when clarification is needed
  • You remain flexible and focused while adapting to changing healthcare priorities, member needs, and business processes

Training and Schedule Expectations

  • Call center hours of operation are Monday-Friday between 8:00 am and 8:00 pm EST
  • The assigned shift for this opportunity will be: 11:30 am – 8:00 pm EST
  • During the first 2 weeks of training, hours will be 8:30am to 5:00 pm EST
  • We consider attendance vital for your success; we will not allow any time off during the 2-week training period.
  • Management must approve time off during the first 90 days ahead of time.
  • We offer extended hours when needs arise. This could include occasional mandatory overtime to include evenings and weekends.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish, with the ability to pass required language proficiency assessments in both languages
  • Minimum of 1 year of experience managing high-volume inbound and outbound calls
  • Experience meeting documented productivity, quality, or service performance metrics
  • Experience navigating, documenting, and updating member or customer information across multiple applications, programs, and platforms
  • Experience using Microsoft Word, Excel, Teams, and Outlook to complete daily work tasks, manage communications, track information, and maintain accurate documentation
  • Ability to work a scheduled 8-hour shift, including a 30-minute lunch, between 11:30 AM and 8:00 PM EST as assigned

Additional Information

Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Interview Format

As part of our hiring process for this opportunity, we will be using an interviewing technology called HireVue to enhance our hiring and decision-making ability. HireVue allows us to quickly connect and gain valuable information from you pertaining to your relevant skills and experience at a time that is best for your schedule.

  • Text Prescreen: Shortly after submitting your application, you may receive both a text message and email requesting you to complete prescreen questions with either yes or no answers. The text message may arrive prior to the email. If you prefer to answer via computer or tablet, wait for the email.

  • Video Prescreen: If you are successful with the text prescreen, you will receive another communication to record a Video Prescreen. This is an online video activity using your phone, tablet, or computer; however, most candidates prefer using a computer or tablet.

  • Interviews: Some candidates will be invited to interview. If so, the recruiter will send an invitation through Hire Vue to schedule a day and time.

  • Offers: Finalists from the interview will be contacted by a recruiter to discuss the offer and benefits for the job

  • Note: Depending on the number of openings, the number of candidates who apply, and the schedules of interviewers and recruiters, this process may take several weeks or less; however, know that we are working hard to proceed as quickly as possible and to keep you informed.

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.$43,000 - $56,200 per year

Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.


About us

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

​

Equal Opportunity Employer

It is the policy of Humana not to discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. It is also the policy of Humana to take affirmative action, in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and VEVRAA, to employ and to advance in employment individuals with disability or protected veteran status, and to base all employment decisions only on valid job requirements. This policy shall apply to all employment actions, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, upgrading, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, recall, termination, rates of pay or other forms of compensation and selection for training, including apprenticeship, at all levels of employment.

raw.description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

The Customer Success Executive is a customer-facing role that ensures our largest customers are wildly successful in delivering on their critical business objectives through leveraging their current Lumen solutions. This is accomplished by viewing our products from the customers’ perspective, monitoring early indicators of customer health, proactively addressing their concerns, and helping them better use our technology to meet their corporate goals and objectives. With established trust and loyalty, this role seeks to naturally progress and expand the partnership through identifying potential up-sell and cross-sell opportunities and engages sales accordingly.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Build long-term, value-based relationships with decisionmakers and influencers to understand the customer’s landscape and establish loyalty
  • Manage overall customer metrics, including usage data, health indicators and renewal dates to align with customer objectives
  • Evaluate product and portal adoption maturity level to address roadblocks and provide best practices and a prescriptive approach to address needs
  • Construct and implement a customer success plan across all steps of the lifecycle, setting expectations for each milestone, ensuring personalized value, and driving positive customer experience to achieve desired outcomes
  • Recognize opportunities for expansion based on knowledge of the Lumen portfolio, partnering with sales as necessary
  • Implement revenue management practices driving accountability and goal alignment, revenue retention and growth strategies including value realization, renewal execution, risk management and customer growth
  • Manage risks to customer success, identify root causes, define and activate solutions, and deploy cross-functional support to resolve
  • Partner with sales, delivery & support to set proper expectations and ensure successful deployment of solutions and services
  • Responsible for defining and executing renewal strategy via clear alignment of customer priorities and roadmap, incorporating on-net migrations, managing writedowns positively impacting Lumen profit margins

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • Experience: 7+ years customer success or account management experience
  • Education Level: Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience
  • Experience in working with complex, Fortune 500, multi-divisional, international customer
  • Comfortable presenting, consulting, and advising at C-level and other executives
  • Assertive verbal and written communications skills with ability to build strategic relationships (deep and wide) within organizations
  • Ability to work closely with the customer and effectively negotiate directly with the customer and internally on their behalf
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into customer insights and leverage with customer engagement strategies

raw.description:
Job Summary:

The Manager, Customer Care & Sales Enablement is responsible for translating SCANA Energy's business strategy, sales and customer experience goals, and operational priorities into practical learning, quality, knowledge management, and readiness initiatives that improve frontline performance. The role serves as the senior leader for both the Training and Quality organizations, ensuring the effectiveness of their leaders, teams, processes, and business results.

Working closely with Customer Care and Sales leadership, the Manager ensures employees, supervisors, and managers have the knowledge, skills, tools, and support needed to deliver strong customer experiences, improve operational performance, and adapt to changing business needs.

This is a player-coach role. While responsible for leading the Learning & Development and Quality Assurance functions, including direct leadership of supervisors within those disciplines, the Manager is also expected to actively design training, develop content, facilitate learning, analyze performance trends, and lead readiness efforts for key business initiatives. The role provides strategic direction, establishes priorities and performance expectations, and develops the leadership capability of the Training and Quality teams while remaining actively engaged in execution.

The Manager, Care & Sales Enablement plays a critical role in improving customer experience, accelerating employee effectiveness, strengthening leadership capability, and supporting ongoing efforts to improve quality, retention, and cost-to-serve.

Primary Responsibilities:

Translate Business Priorities into Frontline Action

  • Partner with Customer Care, Sales, Revenue Assurance, IT and Operations leadership to understand business goals, customer experience priorities, and operational challenges.

  • Translate business strategy into training, coaching, knowledge management, quality, and readiness initiatives.

  • Ensure frontline teams are prepared to successfully support changes in products, offers, policies, systems, and customer programs.

Leadership of Learning & Quality Functions

  • Provide strategic and operational leadership for the Learning & Development and Quality Assurance functions.

  • Lead and develop the managers, supervisors, and team leads responsible for training delivery, curriculum development, quality monitoring, and coaching programs.

  • Establish functional goals, performance expectations, workforce planning, and development strategies for both teams.

  • Ensure alignment of Training and Quality priorities with business objectives, customer experience goals, and operational performance metrics.

  • Build leadership capability within the Training and Quality organizations through coaching, mentoring, succession planning, and talent development.

  • Drive accountability for functional performance, continuous improvement, and business outcomes across both teams.

Learning & Development

  • Design and deliver training that improves employee performance and accelerates time-to-proficiency.

  • Identify skill gaps and development opportunities through quality reviews, performance trends, and leadership feedback.

  • Develop learning pathways that support both frontline employees and leaders.

  • Provide direction to training supervisor on onboarding, ongoing development, leadership training, and performance improvement initiatives.

  • Ensure training supervisor has the structure, resources, and performance measures necessary to deliver effective programs at scale.

Quality Assurance & Performance Improvement

  • Own the Customer Care and Sales Quality Assurance program.

  • Identify themes and trends that impact customer experience and operational performance.

  • Partner with leaders to turn quality findings into targeted coaching, training, and process improvements.

  • Lead the Quality Assurance supervisor in establishing quality standards, calibration processes, reporting practices, and coaching strategies.

  • Partner with the Quality supervisor to prioritize improvement opportunities and ensure quality insights drive measurable business outcomes.

  • Develop the capability of the Quality supervisor to effectively coach operational leaders and influence performance improvements.

Knowledge Management

  • Own the structure, governance, and ongoing improvement of Customer Care and Sales knowledge resources.

  • Ensure employees can easily find accurate information while supporting customers.

  • Improve knowledge adoption and effectiveness through ongoing measurement and feedback.

  • Maintain processes that keep knowledge current and reliable.

Readiness & Change Enablement

  • Develop communication, training, and support plans for new products, offers, processes, systems, and policies.

  • Ensure changes are implemented consistently across teams.

  • Partner with leaders to identify adoption risks and proactively address them.

Measure What Matters

  • Track and evaluate the effectiveness of onboarding, training, quality, and knowledge initiatives.

  • Use data to identify opportunities to improve employee effectiveness and customer outcomes.

  • Provide recommendations based on performance trends and operational needs.

  • Demonstrate the impact of enablement efforts on business performance.

Required Skills:

  • Possess the understanding that training alone does not improve performance.

  • Able to connect business strategy to frontline execution.

  • Able to identify the root causes of performance issues.

  • Proven expertise in building practical solutions that improve results.

  • Focus on developing leaders and employees.

  • Able to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

  • Fundamentally energized by helping people perform at their best and creating systems that allow customer-facing teams to succeed consistently.

  • Strong learning and development capabilities.

  • Experience designing and implementing enablement programs.

  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management abilities.

  • Excellent project management, change management, and communication abilities.

  • Proficiency with CRMs (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot), learning management systems, and performance reporting tools.

Minimum Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or related area.

  • 7-9 years in enablement, learning, customer success, organizational effectiveness or related areas.

  • Experience partnering with leaders to improve organizational and employee performance.

  • Experience leading training, quality, onboarding, or knowledge management programs.

  • Experience leading leaders within leaning, training, quality assurance, customer experience, enablement, or operational excellence functions.

  • Demonstrated success building and scaling high-performing teams through leadership development, coaching, and performance management.

  • Experience managing multiple functions or departments and aligning their priorities to broader business objectives.

Work Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work in the US on a full-time basis. Unfortunately, a current or future need for sponsorship is not supported or available for this position.

Salary Range:

$81,250.00 - $130,000.00

*This range reflects base pay only. Incentive earnings, like commissions or bonuses, are not included.

This role is also eligible for an annual incentive plan based on company performance.

How We Support Your Wellbeing:

Our employees are our most valuable asset. That’s why at IGS, we are committed to offering a holistic benefit program that allows employees to stay healthy, feel secure, and maintain flexibility in their wellbeing journey.

  • Healthcare Essentials: Comprehensive coverage including medical (plus free telehealth), dental, vision, and employer health savings account contributions.

  • Mental Wellbeing: Robust support through Headspace and free mental healthcare visits for you and your dependents.

  • Family Planning Support: Extensive assistance with Maven, paid family and caregiver leave, and fertility, adoption, and surrogacy services.

  • Financial Readiness: Strong financial foundation with a 401(k) plan, company match, and access to financial wellbeing tools.

  • Work-Life Balance: Paid time off, tuition reimbursement, paid leaves, employee hardship fund, and a wide range of additional perks.

This role is responsible for telephone triage, symptom management, care coordination, and crisis support during weekend hours, helping ensure patients receive timely, high-quality end-of-life care.

The ideal candidate is a confident clinician with hospice experience, strong assessment skills, and the ability to provide calm, professional guidance during challenging situations.

  • Documentation: Record all calls, interventions, process workflow and care plans accurately in the electronic medical record (EMR) system.
  • Crisis Support: Guide families through the steps and procedures when a patient passes away at home.

  • Must be able to work in Pacific Time Zone.
  • Experience with Homecare Homebase (HCHB).
  • Strong clinical assessment, triage, and critical thinking skills.
  • Excellent communication and active listening abilities.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Reliable high-speed internet and dedicated HIPAA compliant home workspace.

raw.description:
Overview

We’re seeking an experienced and highly motivated Project Manager/Client Partner to join the team at 8020. This role is ideal for individuals with exceptional organizational skills and a passion for creating seamless client experiences. You’ll be responsible for managing Webflow-based projects from start to finish, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and with high-quality results.

As a Project Manager/Client Partner, you’ll play a dual role—serving as the key point of contact for clients while coordinating with our internal team to align deliverables with expectations. You’ll work closely with clients to define project goals, establish timelines, and manage ongoing communications. Internally, you’ll facilitate team collaboration to ensure the smooth execution of all project phases.

What you’ll do

As a Project Manager/Client Partner at 8020, your role is to drive seamless project execution while delivering an exceptional client experience. You’ll oversee Webflow design and development projects from kickoff to launch, ensuring they are completed on time, within scope, and at the highest quality.

Project Management:

  • Develop comprehensive project plans, including timelines and deliverables, ensuring resource availability and allocation and deliverables

  • Owning the delivery of a project: On time and Budget.

  • Monitor project progress, ensuring tasks are completed on time and aligned with the project scope.

  • Coordinate internal resources and third parties/vendors for the flawless execution of projects and maintain project momentum.

  • Manage project documentation, including task lists, schedules, and status reports, ensuring all stakeholders are aligned.

  • Oversee QA processes for client deliverables to maintain the highest quality standards.

  • Identify and mitigate potential risks, escalating issues as needed to keep projects on track.

  • Be a problem solver for the internal and external stakeholders: Proposing solutions and seeking expertise for problem-solving complex issues affecting the delivery of the project.

  • Establish and maintain relationships with our contractors

  • Ensure all deliverables are completed, and 8020 standards are met

Client Partnership:

  • Act as the main point of contact for clients, providing regular updates and addressing questions or concerns.

  • Coordinate and facilitate regular client meetings.

  • Represent the client in internal meetings, becoming the voice of the client.

  • Build strong client relationships by understanding their goals and ensuring their vision is reflected in deliverables.

  • Anticipate client needs, proactively addressing challenges or opportunities as they arise.

  • Collaborate with clients, designers, developers, and strategists to optimize workflow and deliver excellence.

  • Lead the management of retainer clients by coordinating priorities and tasks effectively.

  • Guide the client through the project process, ensuring they always feel taken care of and in the know.

  • Ensure client satisfaction and retention, and support 8020 efforts in growing each account.

What we’re looking for

  • You are familiar with Webflow’s Website Platform Experience.

  • You’ve worked on Webflow design and development projects to understand at a high level the platform’s constraints and opportunities.

  • You understand the entire lifecycle of a website development project.

  • You have experience overseeing this type of projects and understand their different phases, from content strategy to QA and Launch.

  • You are a proactive problem solver.

  • You don’t wait for challenges to appear — you anticipate them and develop solutions that keep projects moving smoothly.

  • You are highly organized and detail-oriented.

  • You understand that the last 10% of a project is where good work becomes great work.

  • You communicate clearly and confidently.

  • Whether it’s leading a team, guiding clients, or providing constructive feedback, you express ideas in a way that aligns teams and moves projects forward.

  • You have experience managing internal and external teams.

  • You know how to coordinate and support talent, foster a culture of accountability, and set your project team up for success.

  • You have experience creating project plans and documenting processes.

  • You transform a project scope into an actionable plan with a defined timeline. Your ability to document and refine processes keeps the team on track.

Requirements

  • 1+ years of experience in project management, client services, or a related role.

  • Familiarity with Webflow and an understanding of web design principles is a plus.

  • Exceptional communication skills—written, verbal, and presentation.

  • Proven success in managing multiple projects simultaneously in a remote setting.

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize and adapt to shifting deadlines.

  • Experience in client-facing roles with a focus on relationship building.

  • Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., ClickUp or similar).

  • If you’re ready to help us deliver exceptional results for our clients while fostering meaningful relationships, we’d love to hear from you!

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience using ClickUp lists and dashboards to organize, track, and manage projects.

  • Knowledge of Webflow’s structure, including its CMS, interactions, and class-based styling.

  • Eye for design and understanding how design decisions influence development workflows.

About 8020

8020 is a Webflow Enterprise agency trusted by some of the most recognizable brands and creators on the internet. We’ve designed, built, and launched websites for companies like Circle.com, Vanta, Warner Bros, Pilot, Dr. Andrew Huberman, Hasan Minhaj, and many more. From startups to publicly traded enterprises, we help businesses build powerful, scalable, and future-proof websites using Webflow.

We’re not just another agency — we’re a team of problem solvers who challenge what’s possible in Webflow. We work closely with Webflow’s own teams on their largest projects and have a reputation for pushing the limits of the platform. Our work spans industries, from startups launching their first website to large-scale digital transformations for corporations.

We operate with high autonomy, trust, and accountability. There’s no bureaucracy, no micromanagement — just a team of talented, high-agency people working together to do great work. Even though we’re remote, our team stays connected through regular collaboration and annual offsites that strengthen our relationships beyond the screen.

At 8020, we’re always looking to add builders, thinkers, and leaders to our team. If you’re passionate about creating, problem-solving, and working with a high-caliber team, we’d love to meet you.

A peek at (some of) our values

Be Straightforward

No bullshit, no fluff, no jargon. It does not belong. We communicate clearly and honestly, whether with clients, teammates, or partners. Friendly and approachable — but always direct.

People First

We prioritize people over profit. We understand that financial success is important, but we refuse to compromise our team’s well-being or the quality of our work to chase short-term gains.

Do Right

We keep it simple: we aim to be good to the people we do business with. If we mess up, we own it and fix it. If a contract with a client is unclear, we do the right thing and interpret it in their favor.

No Assholes

No egos, no drama, no toxicity. We work with talented, respectful, and kind people — because life is too short to deal with anything else.

Give People Freedom

We’re a remote-first company with minimal meetings. We trust our team to manage their time, work independently, and deliver great results without micromanagement.

Prioritize Momentum

Every day, we work with fast-moving startups and brands, and the reality of the work we do is that waiting for perfect information before making a decision is a luxury we often can't afford. Jeff Bezos summarized this well in his 2016 Letter to Shareholders:

"Most decisions should probably be made with somewhere around 70% of the information you wish you had. If you wait for 90%, in most cases, you’re probably being slow. Plus, either way, you need to be good at quickly recognizing and correcting bad decisions. If you’re good at course-correcting, being wrong may be less costly than you think, whereas being slow is going to be expensive for sure."

Why join 8020?

  • Competitive compensation — we invest in the right people, and that includes competitive pay.

  • Happiness Program — every full-time employee gets $1,000 a year to invest in their health, motivation, or professional growth — whatever makes the biggest impact for them.

  • Yearly offsites — join your teammates for annual offsites in fun locations, getting a chance to collaborate, connect, and unwind in person. (The right person will join us in Cancun, Mexico,

  • for this year's offsite in April!)

  • Work with top Webflow developers — collaborate with some of the best in the industry on high-impact projects for global brands.

  • High-trust, high-autonomy environment — we value independent thinking and initiative.

  • Flexible remote work — work from anywhere with at least 5 hours of overlap with New York City time.

  • Enterprise-level Webflow work — be at the forefront of how Webflow is used at scale, pushing its boundaries.

  • Continuous learning and growth — work in a company that values experimentation, development, and staying ahead of industry trends.

At 8020, we’re not just building websites — we’re helping businesses move faster and scale smarter. If you’re excited about working with a team that values transparency, autonomy, and high-impact work, we’d love to hear from you.

8020 is an equal-opportunity employer. We value diverse perspectives and believe that a variety of backgrounds and experiences make our team stronger. We encourage anyone who resonates with this role to apply, even if you don’t meet every single qualification.

Job Description:

Hornor, Townsend & Kent (HTK), the broker-dealer and registered investment advisor subsidiary of Penn Mutual, operates a standalone Brokerage & Advisory Operations function and is seeking an experienced Director of Operations.

The Director of HTK Operations will be a key driver in shaping the strategic direction for our operational framework.The role will partner closely with key stakeholders to assess and develop people, processes, and technology in support of Financial Professionals and their clients.

Reporting directly to the VP HTK, the Director, HTK Operationswill lead core broker-dealer and RIA back-office functions, including account opening and maintenance, trading support, cashiering, disbursements, suitability review, contact center operations, compensation, and field/advisor support.

Job Description

  • Own broker-dealer and RIA back-office operations: account onboarding, maintenance, new account review, trading support, cashiering, disbursements, ACATs/transfers, suitability, and field advisor support

  • Establish and enforce operational standards, SLAs, KPIs, and an operating cadence including capacity planning, escalation paths, and issue management

  • Oversee supervisory functions for new account review in partnership with the Compliance team, ensuring FINRA, SEC, and MSRB obligations are met

  • Provide regulatory and control oversight, ensuring compliance with FINRA, SEC, and MSRB; maintain strong procedures and readiness; lead exams and remediation efforts.

  • Collaborate with vendors (e.g., Pershing, DTCC, etc.) to improve platforms, integrations, data quality, and operational resiliency.

  • Coach and developHTK team members and people leaderswhile building succession depth.

  • Identify and close significant procedural and control gaps that currently exist in the organization

  • Design and implement scalable, repeatable processes appropriate for a regulated broker-dealer environment

  • Lead regulatory exam readiness and remediation in coordination with Compliance and Risk

  • Lead the implementation of Docupace as the new account workflow, records (books and records), and straight-through processing tool — this is a committed, in-flight initiative

  • Collaborate withtechnology and vendor partners (e.g., Pershing, DTCC, investment platforms) to improve integrations, data quality, and system performance

  • Leverage data and analytics to drive decision-making and surface operational risk proactively

Knowledge,Skills and Abilities

  • Deep expertise in broker-dealer operations and regulatory frameworks (FINRA, SEC, MSRB).

  • Proven success leading operational transformation and technology modernization.

  • Strong strategic thinking, problem solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Strategic, data-driven decision-maker with strong risk awareness.

  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity, driving change, and fostering innovation.

  • Excellent communication skills with ability to translate complex issues into clear insights.

  • Demonstrated ability to build and lead high-performing teams.

Education

  • Bachelor’sDegree is required.

FINARegistrations:Series 65 and 24 required; Series 27 preferred.

Work Experience

  • 10+ years leading teams and driving cross-functional initiatives
    10+ years in life insurance, annuities, or financial services with a focus on agile delivery and digital transformation - required

Base Salary Range - $145,000 - $165,000

For over 175 years, Penn Mutual has empowered individuals, families and businesses on the journey to achieve their financial goals. Through our partnership with Financial Professionals across the U.S., we help instill the confidence and reliability that comes from a stronger financial future. Penn Mutual and its affiliates offer a comprehensive suite of competitive products and services to meet the unique needs of Financial Professionals and their clients, including life insurance, annuities, wealth management and institutional asset management. To learn more, including current financial strength ratings, visit.

Penn Mutual is committed toEqual Employment Opportunity(EEO). We provide employment and advancement opportunities to all qualified applicants and associates, according to applicable laws. This is reflected in our practices for hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, termination, recruitment, compensation, selection or training, and all other terms and conditions of employment. All employment-related decisions and practices are free from unlawful discrimination. This includes: race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship age, gender (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, domestic partnership or civil union status, marital status, genetic information, disability, religious observance or practice, liability, veteran status or any other classification protected under applicable law.

Department Name:

Day

Job Category:

Revenue Cycle

Great careers are built at Banner Health. We understand that talented professionals appreciate having options. We are proud to offer our team members many career and lifestyle choices including remote work options. Apply today, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

The Ambulatory Billing Patient Financial Services Claims Representative responsibilities include:

  • Processing payments, adjustments, claims, correspondence, refunds, denials, financial/charity applications, and/or payment plans in an accurate and timely manner, meeting goals in work quality and productivity.

  • Research payments, denials and/or accounts to determine short/over payments, contract discrepancies, incorrect financial classes, internal/external errors. Makes appeals and corrections as necessary.

  • Works as a member of the patient financial services team to achieve goals in days and dollars of outstanding accounts. Reduces Accounts Receivable balances.

  • Correcting incorrect registration and updating application and billing out the claim.

Systems Used: Cerner Rev Cycle and PowerChart, NextGen, MS4, FinThrive Claims and Collections, payer websites

A/R, Billing, Health Insurance experience desired

Schedule: Monday - Friday between the hours of 6am - 6pm AZ Time

This can be a remote position if you live in the following states only: AK, AZ, AR, CA, CO, GA, FL, IA, ID, IN, KS, KY, LA, MD, MI, MO, MN, MS, NH, NM, NY, NC, ND, NE, NV, OH, OK, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WI, WV, WA, & WY

Within Banner Health Corporate, you will have the opportunity to apply your unique experience and expertise in support of a nationally-recognized healthcare leader. We offer stimulating and rewarding careers in a wide array of disciplines. Whether your background is in Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, Legal, Managed Care Programs or Public Relations, you'll find many options for contributing to our award-winning patient care.

POSITION SUMMARY

This position coordinates and facilitates patient billing and collection activities in one or more assigned areas of billing, payment posting, collections, payor claims research, and other accounts receivable work. Works as a member of a team to ensure reimbursement for services in a timely and accurate manner.

CORE FUNCTIONS

1. May be assigned to process payments, adjustments, claims, correspondence, refunds, denials, financial/charity applications, and/or payment plans in an accurate and timely manner, meeting goals in work quality and productivity. Coordinates with other staff members and physician office staff as necessary ensure correct processing.

2. As assigned, reconciles, balances and pursues account balances and payments, and/or denials, working with payor remits, facility contracts, payor customer service, provider representatives, spreadsheets and the company’s collection/self-pay policies to ensure maximum reimbursement.

3. May be assigned to research payments, denials and/or accounts to determine short/over payments, contract discrepancies, incorrect financial classes, internal/external errors. Makes appeals and corrections as necessary.

4. Builds strong working relationships with assigned business units, hospital departments or provider offices. Identifies trends in payment issues and communicates with internal and external customers as appropriate to educate and correct problems. Provides assistance and excellent customer service to these internal clients.

5. Responds to incoming calls and makes outbound calls as required to resolve billing, payment and accounting issues. Provides assistance and excellent customer service to patients, patient families, providers, and other internal and external customers.

6. Works as a member of the patient financial services team to achieve goals in days and dollars of outstanding accounts. Reduces Accounts Receivable balances.

7. Uses systems to document and to provide statistical data, prepare issues list(s) and to communicate with payors accurately.

8. Works independently under general supervision, following defined standards and procedures. Reports to a Supervisor or Manger. Uses critical thinking skills to solve problems and reconcile accounts in a timely manner. External customers include all hospital patients, patient families and all third party payers. Internal customers include facility medical records and patient financial services staff, attorneys, and central services staff members.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
High school diploma/GED or equivalent working knowledge.

Requires knowledge of patient financial services, financial, collecting services or insurance industry experience processes normally acquired over one or more years of work experience. Requires the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously with minimal supervision and to work independently. Requires strong interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills to effectively interact with a wide range of audiences.

Strong knowledge in the use of common office software, word processing, spreadsheet, and database software are required.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Work experience with the Company’s systems and processes is preferred. Previous cash collections experience is preferred.

Additional related education and/or experience preferred.

Estimated Pay Range:

$18.02 - $27.03 / hourBanner Health is committed to pay equity and transparency. The posted compensation range is a reasonable estimate that extends from the lowest to the highest pay Banner Health in good faith believes it might pay for this particular job, based on the circumstances at the time of posting.This range is based on possible base salaries and does not include the value of our total rewards package. Actual pay determined at offer will be based on years of relevant work experience, education, certifications, skills, and geographic location, along with a review of current employees in similar roles to ensure pay equity is achieved and maintained.

Why Inkit?

Our File Intelligence Platform is trusted by leading commercial enterprises and government agencies alike — with certifications like DoW Impact Level 4 and 5 under our belt and a roadmap toward even broader compliance. raw.description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.

The Role

AspenTech Digital grid Management (DGM) Energy Management system (EMS) provides transmission utilities worldwide with a safe, reliable means to monitor and operate the grid. As a Principal Power Systems Engineer, you will be involved in all aspects of the successful delivery of systems to our customers. You will be highly engaged with our customers, leading efforts to design, build, configure, troubleshoot, and test the deployment of our systems. This position provides you with exposure to EMS Applications such as Power Flow, Contingency Analysis, State Estimator, Optimal Power Flow, Reserve Monitoring, and Stability Analysis. In this role, you will be a primary point of contact with our customers throughout and after the project's lifecycle and will have the opportunity to work across functional teams, including Software Development, Product Management, and Business Development teams.

Your Impact

  • Collaborate with customers and engineering teams to understand requirements and project plans for AspenTech DGM's EMS portfolio.

  • Design, integrate, test, and commission advanced control systems for electric utilities, ensuring optimal performance and reliability.

  • Communicate detailed requirements to internal stakeholders and contribute to the creation of comprehensive project and product documentation.

  • Conduct thorough unit testing and tuning to ensure power system applications meet or exceed customer and industry standards.

  • Install and configure energy management system applications, including Power Flow, State Estimator, Contingency Analysis, and Optimal Power Flow, for seamless integration into customer environments.

  • Partner with AspenTech Digital grid Management (DGM) development teams to troubleshoot, prioritize, and evaluate product enhancements and changes.

  • Develop and deliver training programs to empower customers in effectively utilizing and maintaining their power system applications.

  • Provide expert consultation on power system modeling, ensuring customers maximize the value and capabilities of their systems.

  • Deliver prompt and effective technical support to troubleshoot and resolve issues on live customer systems, utilizing your in-depth knowledge of power systems and application functionalities.

  • Meticulously configure and integrate software components to meet contract specifications, followed by comprehensive testing with customers.

  • Empower customers through hands-on training, equipping them with the skills to confidently operate their newly implemented systems.

What You'll Need

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering is required.

  • Experience in Advanced Power Systems Applications including State Estimator, Contingency Analysis, Study Power Flow, Model management, Optimal Power Flow, Stability Analysis, Forecasting, Operator Training Simulator and may have knowledge of other fields.

  • 8+ years of power systems, project engineering, or related technical project implementation experience required.

  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 20%, both domestically and internationally.

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.

  • Superior problem-solving and analytical abilities.

  • Capacity to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a dynamic environment.

  • Passion for delivering world-class customer service.

  • Strong interpersonal and leadership skills.

Preferred

  • Master’s degree with a focus on Power Systems.

  • The ability to utilize scripting languages (e.g., Python, C) for automation and problem-solving.

The salary range for this role is $127,000.00 - $158,700.00. This range represents what we in good faith believe is the range possible for base compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range based on several factors. This range may be modified in the future. This role is also eligible for bonus or variable incentive pay. Additionally, we offer a comprehensive benefits package including paid time off, charitable giveback day, medical/dental/vision insurance, and retirement benefits to eligible employees.
