raw.description:
POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES

The Claims Examiner is responsible for the accurate and timely processing of medical, dental, vision and prescription drug claims. The incumbent is expected to provide courteous and prompt responses to customer inquiries.

The incumbent is expected to communicate professionally with peers, supervisors, subordinates, vendors, customers, and the public, and to be respectful and courteous in the conduct of this position.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  • Essential job functions include the following. Other functions may be assigned as business conditions change.
  • Verifies the accuracy and receipt of all required documentation for each claim submitted.
  • Collaborates with providers, plan participants, other claims payers, or any other party necessary to obtain information necessary to accurately process a claim.
  • Analyzes information necessary for processing. This includes, but is not limited to, general participant and provider information, managed care affiliation, diagnosis codes, dates, place, type of service, procedure codes, and charges.
  • Assures that the system processes the claim correctly and determines payment according to the plan as written.
  • Word-processes correspondence to plan participants and providers in reference to pre-determinations and in response to basic benefit questions.
  • Answers telephone calls from plan participants, group contacts, and customer service representatives pertaining to benefits and claims inquiries.
  • Resolves problematic claims with the assistance of the Team Leader, Claims Manager and/or the Director of Claims.
  • Assigns critically ill patients to large case management. Assists the case manager with direct negotiation and the efficient use of benefits.
  • Assists other examiners as needed due to workload requirements, including assigned back-up when examiners are absent.
  • Aids the Team Leader and/or the Claims Manager in the resolution of claim appeals and disputes by providing documentation for review.
  • Researches, calculates and requests refunds when necessary.
  • Contributes to the daily workflow with regular and punctual attendance.
  • Thoroughly researches and completes renewal reports in a timely manner in consultation with the Marketing Department.
  • Process eligible claims on groups before the end of their stoploss contract renewal period.
  • Assists the Legal Department with subrogation claims as necessary.
  • Attends various group meetings as required.
  • Assists with audits as needed.
  • Assists with plan benefit set-up and changes as needed.

Minimum Education: High school graduation or GED required.

Minimum Experience: Basic computer and customer service experience required.

Other Qualifications:

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills required.
  • PC skills, including Windows and Word.
  • Ability to learn all functions of the claims processing software as is necessary for claims processing and adjudication.
  • Must be able to adapt to software changes as they occur.
  • Typing ability of 45 wpm net
  • Excellent listening skills.
  • Basic mathematical skills.
  • High level of interpersonal skills to work effectively with others.
  • Ability to organize and recall large amounts of detailed information.
  • Ability to read, analyze and interpret benefit summary plan descriptions, insurance documents, plan benefits, and regulations and make appropriate applications to specific situations.
  • Ability to meet productivity standards with 99% financial accuracy and 95% procedural accuracy.
  • Thorough knowledge of claims processing procedures and requirements.
  • Ability to project a professional image and positive attitude in any work environment.
  • Ability to comply with privacy and confidentiality standards.
  • Ability to be flexible, work under pressure and meet deadlines.
  • Ability to analyze and solve problems with professionalism and patience, and to exercise good judgment when making decisions.
  • Ability to operate typical office equipment.

Job Title

High School Relationship & Recruitment Manager, UK University Partners - Northeast USA

Job Description

Kaplan International Pathways, a division of Kaplan Inc., offers international students a wide range of flexible study options - from university preparation programmes in the UK, Australia, USA and Japan through to full degree programmes in Singapore, Hong Kong and Australia. Through our academic partnerships with leading universities, our expertise in student recruitment, our exceptional teaching and a focus on customer service and pastoral care, each year we are proud to welcome thousands of students from more than 100 countries onto our programmes. As a commercially successful business which has experienced strong growth in recent years, there are excellent opportunities for long-term career progression.

Contribute to Kaplan's success by building and managing strategic relationships with high schools, college counsellors, and school districts across the United States, with the primary focus of recruiting students into undergraduate and pathway programs at Kaplan's partner universities in the United Kingdom. This role owns the full lifecycle of high school engagement — from initial outreach and relationship-building through to converting prospective students and their families into enrolled students at Kaplan's UK university partners. The ideal candidate is an experienced relationship-builder and recruiter who understands the U.S. high school counselling landscape, is knowledgeable about studying in the UK, and can represent a premium, high-value education brand with credibility and professionalism.

Primary/Key Responsibilities

  • Recruit U.S. high school students into undergraduate and pathway programs at Kaplan's partner universities in the United Kingdom
  • Develop and manage a portfolio of high school relationships (counsellors, college advisors, administrators) across an assigned U.S. territory
  • Design and execute a territory recruitment strategy, including school visits, presentations, college fairs, and counsellor events, positioning UK study options as a compelling alternative or complement to U.S. college applications
  • Build Kaplan's brand awareness and credibility among high school counsellors as a trusted source of information and guidance on Kaplan's UK university partners
  • Identify, prospect, and cultivate new high school partnerships to expand Kaplan's UK-bound recruitment network
  • Advise students and families on the UK application process, course options, and life at Kaplan's partner universities
  • Guide prospective students and their parents/guardians through the application journey, from initial interest to enrolment at a UK partner university
  • Meet and exceed recruitment, conversion, and enrolment targets for Kaplan's UK university partners within the assigned territory
  • Document all school visits, counsellor interactions, and student communications in Salesforce CRM
  • Collaborate with the admissions, marketing, and visa advising teams to ensure a seamless experience for referred students
  • Represent Kaplan at national and regional college fairs, conferences, and counsellor association events (e.g., NACAC, regional ACAC chapters)
  • Track and report on territory performance, relationship health, and recruitment pipeline to leadership
  • Travel regularly within the assigned territory to visit high schools and attend recruitment events

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 3 years of experience in student recruitment, college admissions, school partnerships, or a related relationship-management/sales role
  • Demonstrated experience recruiting inside the US high school networks ideally private high schools etc
  • Demonstrable track record of meeting recruitment or sales targets
  • Excellent presentation, public speaking, and interpersonal skills
  • Strong relationship-building skills with an ability to earn trust with US high school counselors and administrators
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage a large, geographically dispersed portfolio of relationships
  • Ability to travel frequently (regional and occasionally national travel required)
  • A valid driver's license and willingness to travel by car and air as needed
  • Cultural awareness and sensitivity when working with diverse student and family populations
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and manage a territory with minimal supervision

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience using Salesforce CRM as a sales or recruitment tool
  • Existing relationships with high school counselors, college advisors, or school districts in the assigned territory
  • Experience with international or pathway education programs, particularly UK-bound student recruitment
  • Familiarity with the U.S. college admissions and counseling landscape
  • Knowledge of the UK higher education system, and Tier 4/Student visa requirements
  • Personal study, work, or living experience in the United Kingdom
  • Fluency in an additional language
  • Experience presenting to student and parent audiences

Beyond base salary, our comprehensive total rewards package includes:

- Remote work provides a flexible work/life balance
- Comprehensive Retirement Package automatically enrolled in The Company Contribution Plan (8-10% annual company contribution based on tenure)
- Our Gift of Knowledge Program provides tuition assistance and substantial discounts for our employees and close family members
- Comprehensive health benefits new hire eligibility starts on day 1 of employment
- Generous Paid Time Off includes paid holidays, vacation, personal, sick paid time-off, plus one (1) volunteer day and one (1) diversity and inclusion day to participate and give back to our local communities

We are committed to providing a supportive and rewarding work environment where every employee can thrive. You can learn more about our full benefits package and total rewards philosophy here.

The salary range for this position is $60,000-$80,000.

Remote/Nationwide, USA

Employee

Senior Vice President, International Sales (International Defense Market)

About Us:

BlackSky is a real-time intelligence company. We own and operate the world's most advanced space-based intelligence platform and provide customers satellite imagery, automated analytics and high-frequency monitoring of strategic locations, economic assets and events from around the globe. BlackSky is trusted by the most demanding allied military and intelligence organizations and commercial companies to deliver foresight into critical matters that affect national security and the economy. BlackSky's data enables governments and businesses to see, understand and anticipate change as it happens, giving them the ultimate strategic advantage so they can act quickly. Our global team works with cutting-edge technology to make a difference around the world and prides itself on being people-first, customer-focused and fun.

We are seeking sales executive to define and execute the international growth strategy and position BlackSky as the premier provider of geospatial and ISR solutions to global defense and government customers. You will be responsible for leading BlackSky’s global sales and business development strategy to achieve sustained international growth and go-to-market leadership in defense and intelligence sector.

This position requires an accomplished executive with deep experience managing long, complex sales cycles and a proven track record of closing high-value contracts with international government organizations. You will oversee the full international sales organization spanning our Space-based intelligence and Analytics, along with Mission Solutions and ensure alignment between customer engagement, product strategy and corporate growth objectives for across the business. We are open to candidates located in certain US states, the United Kingdom, and Dubai. Please note the benefits will vary by location.

Responsibilities:

  • Define and execute a unified global sales strategy to achieve or exceed revenue and profitability targets across international defense and intelligence markets.
  • Lead, develop, and mentor a high-performing international sales and business development organization that delivers measurable, sustained growth.
  • Oversee pursuit and capture of complex, multi-stakeholder opportunities across defense and intelligence customers.
  • Demonstrate a consistent record of closing major international contracts ($10M+) through disciplined, long-cycle capture management.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Program Management teams to align evolving customer requirements with BlackSky’s capabilities.
  • Drive penetration strategies in priority markets and cultivate executive-level relationships with defense and intelligence organizations, commercial partners, and system integrators.
  • Establish accurate forecasting and reporting mechanisms that provide data-driven insights into international pipeline performance.
  • Implement standardized global sales processes, metrics, and accountability frameworks to ensure consistency and operational excellence.
  • Represent BlackSky at key global industry events, strengthening the company’s visibility and thought leadership in the defense, ISR and geospatial sectors.
  • Monitor competitive activity, market dynamics, and emerging technologies to guide strategic planning and positioning.
  • Other responsibilities as assigned.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, or a related technical field.
  • At least 15 years of progressive experience in international sales, business development, or capture management, including at least five years in a senior executive leadership role.
  • Demonstrated success leading and scaling global sales organizations in the defense, ISR or geospatial sectors.
  • Proven ability to manage long, complex sales cycles and close large, high-value international contracts with government customers.
  • Deep understanding of international procurement, contracting, and defense procurement processes, including Foreign Military Sales (FMS) and direct commercial sales (DCS).
  • Strong executive presence with outstanding communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
  • Financial acumen with the ability to forecast, budget, and analyze global sales performance.
  • Exceptional leadership, organizational, and cross-cultural management skills.
  • Established network across the international government market, specifically defense and intelligence organizations focused on ISR and geospatial missions

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated success leading and scaling global sales organizations to deliver complex, sovereign solutions
  • Master’s degree in Business Administration (MBA), Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience integrating and managing enterprise-level CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce, Zendesk) to improve pipeline visibility and forecasting accuracy.
  • In-depth familiarity with international trade compliance, export controls, ITAR/EAR, and FMS procurement.
  • Proven ability to operate effectively across diverse geopolitical and cultural environments.

Life at BlackSky for full-time benefits eligible (US-based) employees includes:

  • Medical, dental, vision, disability, group term life and AD&D, voluntary life and AD&D insurance
    • BlackSky pays 100% of employee-only premiums for medical, dental and vision and contributes $100/month for out-of-pocket expenses!

raw.title: Vice President of Regional Opperations
raw.excerpt: Our StoryTopDog Law is not your typical law firm.
raw.description:
Our Story

TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We're a nationally scaling personal injury firm built for impact and growth — owning the client experience end-to-end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We believe that world-class marketing, paired with exceptional legal talent and operations, creates better experiences and outcomes for clients and the business alike.

Over the past three years, we've grown 2–3x year over year, setting a new standard on the marketing side of the personal injury space and proving what's possible when strategy, speed, and execution align. Now we're applying that same discipline and innovation to firm operations, case management, and national scale — intentionally building the infrastructure, systems, and teams to grow without sacrificing quality, culture, or accountability.

We are a fully remote team that share trust, open communication, and a commitment to doing great work. If you love ownership, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel right at home here.

The Opportunity

If you want a role where your decisions show up directly in a P&L, where you have real access to the executive team, and where the org chart hasn't fully hardened yet, this is that role. TopDog Law is the fastest-growing personal injury firm in the country, and we’re making investments to continue that growth.

We're hiring a VP of Regional Operations to be the operational owner and right hand to leadership across an assigned multi-state region. You'll sit at the center of intake, pre-litigation, litigation, medical and case management, and settlements for your states, connecting state managing attorneys with the centralized platform teams who can partner with them to solve the problems.

You will own making sure the right issues get identified, prioritized by ROI, escalated to the right people, and resolved with feedback back to the states. Your region's profitability is the clearest measure of your impact, and you'll partner closely with the COO and your region's managing attorneys to get there.

What You Will Own

Regional Operational Leadership

  • Serve as the operational lead and primary point of connection across every function touching your region's states, including intake, pre-litigation, litigation, medical and case management, and settlements.
  • Act as the “air traffic controller” for your region. Know what's happening in every state, spot where teams are duplicating effort or dropping the ball, and get the right people working the right problems.
  • Partner with state managing attorneys as operational co-pilots. You are jointly accountable for state performance and for ensuring all teams execute at their highest level.
  • Support new-state launches in your region, including helping stand up managing attorneys, getting case intake and workflows running, and building out the state's operating rhythm.

Prioritization, Escalation and Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Continuously surface operational issues across your states, including provider and client care gaps, tech and product friction, staffing and capacity constraints, and process breakdowns.
  • Translate the long list of things that could be fixed into the handful of highest-ROI priorities for each state, rather than trying to solve everything at once.
  • Route issues to the right centralized or platform team (client care, tech, analytics, marketing, recruiting, training, compliance, intake) and drive them to resolution.
  • Close the loop by making sure state managing attorneys get clear, timely feedback on the status of issues you've escalated on their behalf.
  • Maintain a transparent, recurring view of your region's active priorities and projects so managing attorneys and leadership always know what's being worked and why.

Performance, Accountability and Decision Rights

  • Treat regional P&L as your central KPI. You are expected to know your states' numbers as well as, or better than, anyone else in the business.
  • Build and maintain expected capacity models by role and by state (case managers, legal assistants, litigation staff, and so on), recognizing that the right staffing level differs state to state.
  • Work with managing attorneys and analytics to define KPIs, goals, and scorecards by state that roll up to the regional P&L.
  • Help define where managing attorneys have full decision-making authority versus where changes require a recommendation and sign-off from you or the COO, for example case phase movement criteria, staffing levels, or case cost thresholds. Protect national consistency where it matters while preserving state-level autonomy where it doesn't.

Team Development and Operating Cadence

  • Directly manage and develop an operations manager or right hand, delegating project-based work to them while keeping them fully looped in on regional priorities and decisions.
  • Run or actively participate in your region's operating cadence, including weekly leadership syncs, state-level team meetings, and a monthly regional operating review with managing attorneys, analytics, the COO, and the CEO.
  • Coach state managing attorneys and their teams on prioritization, giving them the information they need to run their state and recognizing where you're seeing deficiencies before they become bigger problems.

What You Bring

Required:

  • 5+ years of operations leadership experience, ideally spanning multiple sites, states, or business units in a fast-growing or professional services environment
  • Strong financial and P&L fluency. Comfortable using a profit-and-loss statement to prioritize, not just review, operational work (accounting, finance, or analytical background strongly preferred)
  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize a large volume of competing issues by ROI and impact, and communicate that prioritization clearly to stakeholders at every level
  • Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, with a proven ability to influence and drive execution through people you don't directly manage
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity within a fast-scaling, still-being-defined organizational structure
  • Working knowledge of, or strong aptitude to quickly learn, the full personal injury case lifecycle: intake and case value, pre-litigation, litigation, medical and case management, and settlements
  • Experience developing and delegating to direct reports, with the judgment to know when to go deep yourself and when to hand something off, and to whom
  • Willingness to travel occasionally to states within your assigned region
  • High intellectual curiosity, strong organizational skills, and genuine enjoyment of connecting people and solving cross-functional problems

Preferred:

  • Experience leading operations for a multi-state or multi-office personal injury law firm, with direct exposure to intake, pre-litigation, litigation, and settlements
  • A track record of partnering with attorneys or partners on business and operational performance, not just running internal operations in isolation
  • Familiarity with legal case management systems and how case-level data translates into staffing, KPI, and financial decisions
  • Experience standing up or scaling a regional operating model inside a high-growth company

Growth and Impact

This role sits inside a company significantly growing and optimizing its operating model, not maintaining one that's already set. You'll have direct visibility with senior leadership, real influence over how our national operating standards evolve, and the chance to build a track record running a multi-million-dollar P&L rather than just contributing to one.

Who Thrives Here (Core Values)

We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

  • Embrace Change: Open to feedback, embracing change, and always asking “what's next?”
  • Committed: You care deeply, have your teammates' backs, and show up to build something lasting.
  • No-Ego Energy: Positive, professional, and solutions-oriented. Drama stays at the door.
  • Ownership: You do what you say, follow through, and treat the business like it's yours.
  • Fast & Hungry: You move with urgency, thrive under high expectations, and are motivated by growth and impact.

What We Offer

  • Base Salary: $180,000 to $210,000, commensurate with experience
  • Eligible for a performance-based bonus tied to regional profitability
  • Our job postings reflect the compensation range for the specific market and location of each role. Ranges vary by geography based on local market rates and cost of labor.
  • Benefits include: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, HSA, life insurance, disability coverage, paid time off, and parental leave.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are an equal opportunity employer. Employment selection and related decisions are made without regard to age, race, color, national origin, religion, sex, disability, sexual orientation, gender identification, or being a qualified disabled veteran or qualified veteran of the Vietnam era or any other category protected by Federal or State law.

Responsibilities

The Health and Financial Solutions team is looking for a Test Engineer to support the testing lifecycle for Medicare claims processing systems operating on a legacy mainframe platform. This role requires expertise in validating Durable Medical Equipment (DME) claim workflows, ensuring compliance with CMS (Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services) regulations, and managing test cases within TestRail. The engineer will collaborate with business analysts, developers, and operations to design, execute, and automate test suites for both functional and regression testing.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain automated test scripts for critical Medicare claim workflows in the mainframe environment (batch and online).
  • Integrate automated test suites with TestRail for execution tracking and reporting.
  • Continuously assess regression suites for automation opportunities to improve test coverage, speed, and repeatability.
  • Develop, manage, and execute test cases within TestRail aligned to Medicare claims workflows and CMS requirements.
  • Perform functional, regression, and integration testing for mainframe batch and online applications.
  • Validate COBOL/JCL jobs, DB2/VSAM database updates, and downstream claim adjudication outputs.
  • Collaborate with developers, analysts, and operations to resolve defects and ensure test coverage.
  • Create and maintain test data to simulate Medicare claim scenarios (inpatient, outpatient, Part A, Part B, adjustments, rejections, etc.).
  • Ensure compliance with CMS testing standards and audit documentation.
  • Track and report test results, defects, and quality metrics in TestRail and JIRA (or equivalent defect tracking tool).
  • Participate in defect triage meetings and root cause analysis.

Qualifications

Required Skills & Experience

  • 2 years with BS/BA, 6 years no degree.
  • Proficiency in mainframe environments, including JCL, COBOL (reading and debugging), DB2 SQL queries, and VSAM file handling.
  • Proven experience with test case management and orchestration tools including Quick Test Pro, Open Text Unified Functional Testing (UFT), and TestRail, to design, execute maintain automated test cases.
  • Familiarity with Medicare claims processing, including 837/835 EDI transactions, claim adjudication logic, andCMS compliancerequirements.
  • Experience using defect tracking toolssuch asJira, or equivalent platforms to manage defects and testing workflow.
  • Solid understanding of Agile and Hybrid Agile/Waterfall testing methodologies, with the ability to adapt test strategies to evolving delivery models.
  • Ability to interpret and analyze business and system requirements, translating them into detailed and reusable test cases and automation scripts.
  • Strong attention to detail, with disciplined documentation practices to supportaudit and regulatory compliancestandards.
  • US Citizen and have the ability to obtain a Public Trust clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with automated testing frameworks for mainframe (e.g., CA Verify, Compuware Test Automation, REXX scripting).
  • Knowledge of CMS regulatory changes (e.g., ICD-10, HIPAA, DMEPOS).
  • Prior experience in healthcare payer systems or CMS audit environments.
  • Familiarity with DevOps pipelines and CI/CD integration with test management software.

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Target Salary Range

$86,000 - $138,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

EEO

EEO: Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

O(a)Especialista Business Owner de Cadastro e Onboardingatua como um facilitador estratégico para a entrada de novas revendedoras nos canais digitais. Este profissional articula a tradução das regras de negócio em jornadas digitais, atuando em estreita parceria com os times de Tecnologia, Comunicação, Mídia e Ativação Digital, priorizando entregas que geram maior valor para o revendedor e resultado para o negócio.

Quer construir o maior ecossistema de beleza do mundo com a gente, em uma área com grande diversidade de assuntos, muita oportunidade de empreender dentro do canal de Venda Direta, com a oportunidade de participar de evoluções importantes em temas estruturantes e com alto impacto para a organização?

Então vem fazer beleza com a gente! Inscreva-se!

  • Evolução da Jornada: Assegurar a fluidez e a excelência da experiência do usuário nos portais de cadastro (APP e Landing Pages). Trabalhar em conjunto com os times para que as pessoas interessadas no modelo de negócio consigam entender o potencial de se tornarem revendedores do grupo

  • Liderar a co-construção de soluções definitivas: Priorização da automação de fluxos, a rastreabilidade dos processos e a clareza na comunicação;

LEUKAEMIA CARE TRUSTEE - REMOTE

UNPAID - VOLUNTEER

- Clinical

As part of the Board, you will be responsible for the organisation’s governance, strategic direction and sustainability alongside a highly committed and welcoming team. Your commitment will extend to:

  • Board of Trustees meetings (four per year*).
  • In-person attendance at the charity’s AGM (full day).
  • Contribute to the work of Sub-committee (around three per year).
  • Ad hoc availability as matters arise (by telephone/teleconference).
  • Attendance at key Leukaemia Care events.
  • Commit to the Board of Trustees for at least four years.

*Board meetings take place in hybrid form. Trustees can claim reasonable expenses, including help with travel and childcare.

Leukaemia Care is the UK’s leading leukaemia charity. For over 50 years, we have been dedicated to ensuring that everyone affected by leukaemia and associated conditions receives the best possible diagnosis, information, advice, treatment, and support.

In 2024, our support services were accessed more than 60,000 times.

  • Over £100,000 was paid out to those in need via our Cost of Living fund.
  • Over 600 people were supported by Leukaemia Care navigators in hospitals across the country.
  • Our Advice Service was accessed over 2,000 times.

“You fear the worst when you’re diagnosed with cancer, but Leukaemia Care provides compassion, help and support for those in need.”

Leukaemia Care’s Board of Trustees works to ensure that the charity is able to fully deliver on its purpose and mission. The Trustees are responsible for the effective and legal governance of the organisation, making sure that the charity is carrying out the purposes for which it was established, and is working for the public benefit and in line with the charity’s own governing documents.

The Board is currently looking for potential Trustees from across the UK who are able to bring knowledge and experience in the fields ofxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx

  • Good people and collaborative skills.
  • Able to commit enough time to the role.
  • Diplomacy and sensitivity.
  • Confidentiality.
  • Good independent judgment.
  • Ability to work effectively as a member of a team.
  • Integrity, openness, honesty.

There are a number of rules stipulated by the Charity Commission regarding the qualification of a person to act as a Trustee. Leukaemia Care will always undertake due diligence checks, (such as DBS) to ensure that all members of the Board meet these standards.

You don’t need to have been a Trustee before. What matters is your commitment to our values and your ability to think strategically, challenge constructively, and act in the best interests of the charity.

Microsoft Cloud Operations and Innovation (CO+I) powers the global infrastructure behind Microsoft's cloud platforms. Within CO+I, EPC is responsible for delivering hyperscale datacenter programs that enable continued growth of Microsoft's cloud services worldwide.

As anIntegrated Planning & Scheduling Program Managerfor Microsoft EPC Central Team, you will play a critical role in delivering Microsoft's global Data Center portfolio. You will develop, manage, and optimise Plan of Record (POR) schedules from early design through approval and deployment, ensuring projects are planned realistically, executed efficiently, and supported by data-driven decision making.

You will act as a trusted planning expert, applying industry-leading scheduling practices, Critical Path Method (CPM) principles, and risk-based insights to build high-quality, integrated schedules.

Working closely with stakeholders across the business, you will validate sequencing and durations, drive schedule governance, and improve predictability through scenario modelling, schedule analytics, and acceleration planning.

The Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) team delivers complex, multi-year infrastructure programmes across multiple regions, bringing together expertise in engineering, construction, sourcing, project controls, and delivery. Success depends on strong cross-functional collaboration, proactive risk management, and disciplined execution at scale.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

This role is primarily based in Dublin, IRL, with flexibility to be located in one of Microsoft's approved EMEA hub locations, including Milan, IT, Amsterdam, NL, or London, GBR, subject to business needs. This role is eligible for hybrid or remote work, up to 3 dayswith the option to fully remote.

  • Planning & Schedule Management:Support global planning initiatives that improve schedule quality, governance, predictability, and consistency across EPC Project Controls programs. Partner with Central Project Controls Estimating, Cost, Risk, regional planning leadership, and cross-functional teams to align global strategy with regional execution needs.
  • Schedule & Planning Expertise:Serve as a subject matter expert in Primavera P6 EPPM and integrated master schedule best practices. Support the development of Plan of Record and Integrated Master Schedules, validate durations, drive bottom-up planning aligned with the Basis of Estimate, and strengthen schedule integration, benchmarking, and portfolio performance analysis.
  • Data, Reporting & Analytics:Work closely with the Reporting and Analytics Team to develop enhanced reporting solutions, translate complex schedule and performance data into clear leadership insights, and support KPI frameworks for schedule health, performance tracking, and governance.

Create and maintain program processes, procedures, and guidance while supporting continuous learning and improved planning maturity across EPC.

  • Experience developing and managing complex, large-scale project schedules.

  • Experience managing hyperscale Data Centre programs across multiple regions, business units, or large portfolios.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong communication and technical writing skills with experience presenting to senior leadership / Director level

  • Experience developing and implementing processes, procedures, and governance frameworks

IT Senior Architect – Windows Server & Infrastructure

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced IT Architect – Windows Server & Infrastructure to join our global Digital organization.

This role is responsible for defining, governing and evolving the enterprise architecture for Microsoft server platforms and core infrastructure services. The architect owns the technology roadmap, architecture standards and design principles for Windows-based infrastructure across on-premises datacenters.

The IT operations are outsourced to an external service provider. Therefore, this role is primarily architecture- and governance-focused rather than operational, with a strong emphasis on collaborating with and steering the managed service partner to ensure architectural standards, security requirements, cost optimizations and strategic objectives are effectively implemented.

The architect acts as the technical authority for Windows Server and infrastructure-related technologies, translating business requirements into scalable, resilient and secure technology solutions while supporting the organization's digital transformation and hybrid cloud strategy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the enterprise architecture for Windows Server and infrastructure platforms.

  • Define and maintain technology roadmaps for server, identity, virtualization, backup and datacenter infrastructure services.

  • Develop architecture standards, reference designs and governance guidelines.

  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend modernization opportunities.

  • Drive infrastructure standardization, consolidation and simplification initiatives.

  • Ensure alignment between infrastructure architecture, cybersecurity requirements and enterprise architecture principles.

  • Define architecture and technical standards for:

    • Microsoft Windows Server platforms

    • Identity Federation and Single Sign-On (SSO)

    • DNS and DHCP services

    • Microsoft SQL Server infrastructure

    • Backup (Veeam) and Disaster Recovery solutions

    • File and Print Services

    • Virtualization platforms (VxRail hypervisor)

    • Datacenter hosting infrastructure

    • Infrastructure monitoring and management platforms

  • Review and approve infrastructure solution designs.

  • Act as design authority for strategic projects and infrastructure changes.

  • Ensure outsourced services comply with architecture standards and best practices.

  • Manage technical escalations and architectural risks.

  • Participate in architecture review boards and governance forums.

  • Support critical incident and problem management activities when architectural expertise is required.

  • Maintain architecture documentation, standards and technical decision records.

  • Create and maintain technical reference architectures and implementation guidelines.

  • Identify cost optimization opportunities and technical debt reduction initiatives.

  • Drive continuous improvement and operational excellence across infrastructure services.

Required Experience and Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in infrastructure architecture, enterprise architecture, or senior infrastructure engineering roles.

  • Experience designing and operating enterprise-scale hybrid infrastructure environments.

  • Experience working in global organizations with complex IT landscapes.

  • Experience managing and governing outsourced infrastructure services.

  • Proven track record delivering infrastructure transformation and modernization initiatives.

  • Strong knowledge of Hybrid Cloud Architecture, Infrastructure Security and Hardening

  • Solid understanding of Virtualization Technologies (VxRail hypervisor / VMware)

  • Strong knowledge in Automation and Scripting (e.g. PowerShell) and High Availability and Fault-Tolerant Design Principles

  • Familiarity with ITIL processes and enterprise architecture frameworks (e.g. TOGAF)

  • Strategic thinker with a strong ownership mindset.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

  • Ability to balance business requirements, risk, cost and technology considerations.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Results-oriented with a focus on quality and continuous improvement.

  • Clear communicator, able to translate technical solutions for non-technical stakeholders.

  • Documentation lover, enjoys writing documents to share knowledge and support others.

Job Description:

The Sr. Talent Acquisition Partner is a senior recruiting professional responsible for leading talent acquisition strategies and full-cycle recruitment for engineering, research and development, technical operations, manufacturing, and professional-level positions across FormFactor's global business.

Serving as a strategic talent advisor to business leaders, this role partners closely with engineering and functional leadership to anticipate workforce needs, develop proactive talent strategies, and deliver hiring outcomes that support critical business objectives. The Talent Acquisition Partner leverages deep expertise in semiconductor and engineering recruiting, labor market intelligence, talent mapping, and consultative influence to identify and attract specialized technical talent in highly competitive markets.

The ideal candidate brings a proven track record of recruiting highly specialized engineering talent, advising senior leaders on workforce planning decisions, developing long-term talent pipelines, and driving recruiting initiatives that improve organizational capability, candidate experience, and business results.

This role operates with a high degree of autonomy, managing highly complex searches, influencing hiring decisions, leading talent acquisition projects, and serving as a subject matter expert within the Talent Acquisition function.

Key Responsibilities:

Full-Cycle Recruiting

  • Lead end-to-end recruitment for engineering, technical, manufacturing, leadership, and business-critical positions across multiple functions and geographic regions.

  • Partner with hiring leaders to develop recruiting strategies aligned with organizational priorities, business growth plans, and workforce needs.

  • Facilitate intake sessions, calibration discussions, interview strategy development, candidate assessments, offer negotiations, and hiring decisions.

  • Independently manage highly specialized, hard-to-fill, and business-critical searches.

  • Ensure hiring activities comply with employment regulations, internal policies, and recruiting best practices.

  • Drive exceptional hiring manager and candidate experiences while balancing quality, speed, and business impact.

Strategic Talent Sourcing & Market Intelligence

Develop and execute advanced sourcing and talent acquisition strategies for specialized technical talent that may include RF & Signal Integrity, Optical Engineering & Silicon Photonics, Co-Packaged Optics (CPO), Thermal Characterization, Probe Card Engineering, MEMS, Electrical, Mechanical and Systems Engineering, Semiconductor Process and Test Engineering, Packaging, Reliability, Materials, Yield, Product Engineering, and Advanced Manufacturing Automation.

Additional technical domains or functional areas may be assigned based on evolving business needs.

  • Conduct talent mapping, competitive intelligence, and labor market analysis to inform hiring strategies.

  • Identify emerging talent trends and advise leaders on market realities, talent availability, and competitive positioning.

  • Develop innovative sourcing approaches that expand access to specialized and passive talent pools.

Talent Pipeline Development & Workforce Planning

  • Build and maintain strategic talent pipelines aligned with current and future workforce requirements.

  • Partner with business leaders to anticipate future talent needs and identify succession or organizational capability risks.

  • Develop and execute long-term pipeline strategies for critical skill sets and business priorities.

  • Support workforce planning activities by providing talent market insights, external benchmarking, and recruiting recommendations.

Strategic Business Partnership

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to hiring managers, directors, and senior leaders on talent acquisition strategy and hiring decisions.

  • Influence hiring outcomes through consultative guidance, market expertise, and data-driven recommendations.

  • Educate leaders on labor market conditions, talent competitiveness, compensation positioning, and candidate behaviors.

  • Provide thought leadership regarding recruitment best practices, talent availability, organizational design considerations, and hiring process effectiveness.

Leadership & Talent Acquisition Projects

  • Lead or participate in enterprise recruiting initiatives, process improvements, employer branding efforts, and workforce programs.

  • Serve as a mentor and resource to Talent Acquisition team members by sharing sourcing techniques, recruiting best practices, and market intelligence.

  • Contribute to the development of recruiting standards, tools, and scalable hiring processes.

Candidate Experience & Employer Brand

  • Deliver a consultative, high-touch experience for candidates and hiring teams throughout the recruiting lifecycle.

  • Represent FormFactor as an employer of choice through industry networking, conferences, professional associations, university partnerships, and recruiting events.

  • Promote and strengthen FormFactor's employment brand within the engineering and technical talent marketplace.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • 8+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including significant experience supporting engineering or technical organizations.

  • Semiconductor industry recruiting experience strongly preferred.

  • Demonstrated success recruiting highly specialized engineering and technical talent.

  • Experience partnering with directors, senior leaders, and executive stakeholders.

  • Expertise in advanced sourcing methodologies, talent mapping, and passive candidate engagement.

  • Strong labor market intelligence and workforce planning capabilities.

  • Proven ability to manage multiple complex and business-critical searches simultaneously.

  • Strong negotiation, influencing, and offer-closing skills.

  • Excellent written, verbal, and consultative communication skills.

  • Experience utilizing ATS and recruiting technologies (Workday preferred).

  • Experience supporting global organizations and multi-site recruiting environments.

  • Test & measurement industry recruiting experience preferred.

Location & Travel

This position is remote and may be based anywhere within Texas. Periodic travel to FormFactor locations, industry or recruiting events, and business meetings is required. Travel may be up to 10%, depending on business needs and recruiting priorities.

Farmers Branch, TX

BlackSky is a real-time intelligence company. We own and operate the world's most advanced space-based intelligence platform and provide customers satellite imagery, automated analytics and high-frequency monitoring of strategic locations, economic assets and events from around the globe. BlackSky is trusted by the most demanding allied military and intelligence organizations and commercial companies to deliver foresight into critical matters that affect national security and the economy. BlackSky's data enables governments and businesses to see, understand and anticipate change as it happens, giving them the ultimate strategic advantage so they can act quickly. Our global team works with cutting-edge technology to make a difference around the world and prides itself on being people-first, customer-focused and fun.

We are seeking sales executive to define and execute the international growth strategy and position BlackSky as the premier provider of geospatial and ISR solutions to global defense and government customers. You will be responsible for leading BlackSky’s global sales and business development strategy to achieve sustained international growth and go-to-market leadership in defense and intelligence sector.

This position requires an accomplished executive with deep experience managing long, complex sales cycles and a proven track record of closing high-value contracts with international government organizations. You will oversee the full international sales organization spanning our Space-based intelligence and Analytics, along with Mission Solutions and ensure alignment between customer engagement, product strategy and corporate growth objectives for across the business. We are open to candidates located in certain US states, the United Kingdom, and Dubai. Please note the benefits will vary by location.

Job Description Summary

The Training Operations Program Leader is responsible for driving operational excellence across the US & Canada Service Training Enablement organization. This role serves as a critical link between field service leadership, training delivery teams, and global program stakeholders to ensure employees receive the right technical training at the right time.

The position leads operational programs supporting workforce readiness, training demand planning, capacity management, escalation resolution, learner support, analytics, and continuous improvement initiatives. The role partners closely with field service leaders, Training Enablement Specialists, Global Service Program Managers, and cross-functional stakeholders to improve employee readiness, customer outcomes, and business performance.

Success in this role requires strong operational leadership, analytical rigor, stakeholder influence, and a commitment to delivering exceptional customer and employee experiences. As an integral member of the Training Operations team, this individual is expected to demonstrate a safety-first mindset while supporting compliant execution in accordance with applicable Quality Management System (QMS) requirements and Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) policies and procedures. The role also promotes a culture of inclusion, collaboration, continuous improvement, and people development throughout the organization.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead operational programs supporting technical training delivery and workforce readiness across the US & Canada Service organization.

  • Translate training demand, business priorities, workforce readiness requirements, and resource constraints into actionable operational plans that support field readiness and business objectives.

  • Drive training demand planning, capacity forecasting, resource optimization, and backlog management activities to improve training accessibility, compliance, and utilization.

  • Serve as the primary operational leader for training demand, capacity, and escalations, partnering with field service leaders and global stakeholders to resolve critical readiness needs and optimize training outcomes.

  • Partner with field service leadership, Area Service Leaders, Market Service Directors, Training Enablement Specialists, and Global Program Managers to understand readiness requirements and continuously improve training effectiveness.

  • Analyze operational metrics, forecasts, dashboards, and business trends to identify risks, opportunities, and improvement actions that support strategic decision-making.

  • Lead cross-functional projects and initiatives that improve training operations, learner experience, operational performance, and business outcomes.

  • Drive continuous improvement efforts using Lean principles and structured problem-solving methodologies to simplify processes, eliminate waste, and improve operational efficiency.

  • Influence decisions across multiple organizational levels by communicating operational insights, recommendations, risks, and improvement opportunities to business and functional leaders.

  • Ensure compliant execution of training operations by maintaining applicable processes, documentation, controls, and records in accordance with Quality Management System and EHS requirements.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert within the Training Enablement organization and provide leadership, guidance, and support to stakeholders across the training ecosystem.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of 6 years of experience in technical training operations, workforce enablement, training compliance, workforce readiness programs, or service training operations. Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university, or high school diploma/GED, required.

  • Demonstrated experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.

  • Experience using operational metrics, dashboards, forecasting tools, analytics, or business intelligence platforms to support decision-making and drive measurable outcomes.

  • Demonstrated program or project management experience, including planning, prioritization, execution, stakeholder management, and risk mitigation.

  • Experience supporting customer-facing operations, workforce readiness programs, technical training compliance programs, training operations, or service organizations.

  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes, evaluate alternatives, and implement sustainable solutions.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with employees, leaders, and cross-functional partners.

  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, influence without direct authority, and drive results in a matrixed organization.

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience supporting technical training, workforce enablement, learning operations, service training, or training operations organizations.

  • Knowledge of GE HealthCare Service Training operations, Training Enablement processes, technical training pathways, training governance processes, or related operational workflows.

  • Experience partnering with field service organizations, Area Service Leaders, Market Service Directors, technical support teams, or customer operations organizations.

  • Experience with training demand planning, capacity planning, enrollment management, workforce readiness programs, competency management, or operational forecasting.

  • Experience using Power BI, learning management systems, training analytics tools, or related business intelligence platforms.

  • Experience leading Lean, Kaizen, continuous improvement, or process optimization initiatives.

  • Experience working in healthcare, medical technology, industrial services, technical services, or other highly regulated operational environments.

  • Experience working with global teams and stakeholders in a matrixed organization.

  • Demonstrated ability to drive change management, process standardization, and operational transformation initiatives.

  • Experience supporting Quality Management System (QMS) processes or regulated business environments.

raw.title: Vice President of Regional Opperations
raw.excerpt: Our StoryTopDog Law is not your typical law firm.
raw.description:
Our Story

TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We're a nationally scaling personal injury firm built for impact and growth — owning the client experience end-to-end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We believe that world-class marketing, paired with exceptional legal talent and operations, creates better experiences and outcomes for clients and the business alike.

Over the past three years, we've grown 2–3x year over year, setting a new standard on the marketing side of the personal injury space and proving what's possible when strategy, speed, and execution align. Now we're applying that same discipline and innovation to firm operations, case management, and national scale — intentionally building the infrastructure, systems, and teams to grow without sacrificing quality, culture, or accountability.

We are a fully remote team that share trust, open communication, and a commitment to doing great work. If you love ownership, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel right at home here.

The Opportunity

If you want a role where your decisions show up directly in a P&L, where you have real access to the executive team, and where the org chart hasn't fully hardened yet, this is that role. TopDog Law is the fastest-growing personal injury firm in the country, and we’re making investments to continue that growth.

We're hiring a VP of Regional Operations to be the operational owner and right hand to leadership across an assigned multi-state region. You'll sit at the center of intake, pre-litigation, litigation, medical and case management, and settlements for your states, connecting state managing attorneys with the centralized platform teams who can partner with them to solve the problems.

You will own making sure the right issues get identified, prioritized by ROI, escalated to the right people, and resolved with feedback back to the states. Your region's profitability is the clearest measure of your impact, and you'll partner closely with the COO and your region's managing attorneys to get there.

What You Will Own

Regional Operational Leadership

  • Serve as the operational lead and primary point of connection across every function touching your region's states, including intake, pre-litigation, litigation, medical and case management, and settlements.
  • Act as the “air traffic controller” for your region. Know what's happening in every state, spot where teams are duplicating effort or dropping the ball, and get the right people working the right problems.
  • Partner with state managing attorneys as operational co-pilots. You are jointly accountable for state performance and for ensuring all teams execute at their highest level.
  • Support new-state launches in your region, including helping stand up managing attorneys, getting case intake and workflows running, and building out the state's operating rhythm.

Prioritization, Escalation and Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Continuously surface operational issues across your states, including provider and client care gaps, tech and product friction, staffing and capacity constraints, and process breakdowns.
  • Translate the long list of things that could be fixed into the handful of highest-ROI priorities for each state, rather than trying to solve everything at once.
  • Route issues to the right centralized or platform team (client care, tech, analytics, marketing, recruiting, training, compliance, intake) and drive them to resolution.
  • Close the loop by making sure state managing attorneys get clear, timely feedback on the status of issues you've escalated on their behalf.
  • Maintain a transparent, recurring view of your region's active priorities and projects so managing attorneys and leadership always know what's being worked and why.

Performance, Accountability and Decision Rights

  • Treat regional P&L as your central KPI. You are expected to know your states' numbers as well as, or better than, anyone else in the business.
  • Build and maintain expected capacity models by role and by state (case managers, legal assistants, litigation staff, and so on), recognizing that the right staffing level differs state to state.
  • Work with managing attorneys and analytics to define KPIs, goals, and scorecards by state that roll up to the regional P&L.
  • Help define where managing attorneys have full decision-making authority versus where changes require a recommendation and sign-off from you or the COO, for example case phase movement criteria, staffing levels, or case cost thresholds. Protect national consistency where it matters while preserving state-level autonomy where it doesn't.

Team Development and Operating Cadence

  • Directly manage and develop an operations manager or right hand, delegating project-based work to them while keeping them fully looped in on regional priorities and decisions.
  • Run or actively participate in your region's operating cadence, including weekly leadership syncs, state-level team meetings, and a monthly regional operating review with managing attorneys, analytics, the COO, and the CEO.
  • Coach state managing attorneys and their teams on prioritization, giving them the information they need to run their state and recognizing where you're seeing deficiencies before they become bigger problems.

What You Bring

Required:

  • 5+ years of operations leadership experience, ideally spanning multiple sites, states, or business units in a fast-growing or professional services environment
  • Strong financial and P&L fluency. Comfortable using a profit-and-loss statement to prioritize, not just review, operational work (accounting, finance, or analytical background strongly preferred)
  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize a large volume of competing issues by ROI and impact, and communicate that prioritization clearly to stakeholders at every level
  • Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, with a proven ability to influence and drive execution through people you don't directly manage
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity within a fast-scaling, still-being-defined organizational structure
  • Working knowledge of, or strong aptitude to quickly learn, the full personal injury case lifecycle: intake and case value, pre-litigation, litigation, medical and case management, and settlements
  • Experience developing and delegating to direct reports, with the judgment to know when to go deep yourself and when to hand something off, and to whom
  • Willingness to travel occasionally to states within your assigned region
  • High intellectual curiosity, strong organizational skills, and genuine enjoyment of connecting people and solving cross-functional problems

Preferred:

  • Experience leading operations for a multi-state or multi-office personal injury law firm, with direct exposure to intake, pre-litigation, litigation, and settlements
  • A track record of partnering with attorneys or partners on business and operational performance, not just running internal operations in isolation
  • Familiarity with legal case management systems and how case-level data translates into staffing, KPI, and financial decisions
  • Experience standing up or scaling a regional operating model inside a high-growth company

Growth and Impact

This role sits inside a company significantly growing and optimizing its operating model, not maintaining one that's already set. You'll have direct visibility with senior leadership, real influence over how our national operating standards evolve, and the chance to build a track record running a multi-million-dollar P&L rather than just contributing to one.

Who Thrives Here (Core Values)

We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

  • Embrace Change: Open to feedback, embracing change, and always asking “what's next?”
  • Committed: You care deeply, have your teammates' backs, and show up to build something lasting.
  • No-Ego Energy: Positive, professional, and solutions-oriented. Drama stays at the door.
  • Ownership: You do what you say, follow through, and treat the business like it's yours.
  • Fast & Hungry: You move with urgency, thrive under high expectations, and are motivated by growth and impact.

What We Offer

  • Base Salary: $180,000 to $210,000, commensurate with experience
  • Eligible for a performance-based bonus tied to regional profitability
  • Our job postings reflect the compensation range for the specific market and location of each role. Ranges vary by geography based on local market rates and cost of labor.
  • Benefits include: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, HSA, life insurance, disability coverage, paid time off, and parental leave.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are an equal opportunity employer. Employment selection and related decisions are made without regard to age, race, color, national origin, religion, sex, disability, sexual orientation, gender identification, or being a qualified disabled veteran or qualified veteran of the Vietnam era or any other category protected by Federal or State law.

Responsibilities

The Health and Financial Solutions team is looking for a Test Engineer to support the testing lifecycle for Medicare claims processing systems operating on a legacy mainframe platform. This role requires expertise in validating Durable Medical Equipment (DME) claim workflows, ensuring compliance with CMS (Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services) regulations, and managing test cases within TestRail. The engineer will collaborate with business analysts, developers, and operations to design, execute, and automate test suites for both functional and regression testing.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain automated test scripts for critical Medicare claim workflows in the mainframe environment (batch and online).
  • Integrate automated test suites with TestRail for execution tracking and reporting.
  • Continuously assess regression suites for automation opportunities to improve test coverage, speed, and repeatability.
  • Develop, manage, and execute test cases within TestRail aligned to Medicare claims workflows and CMS requirements.
  • Perform functional, regression, and integration testing for mainframe batch and online applications.
  • Validate COBOL/JCL jobs, DB2/VSAM database updates, and downstream claim adjudication outputs.
  • Collaborate with developers, analysts, and operations to resolve defects and ensure test coverage.
  • Create and maintain test data to simulate Medicare claim scenarios (inpatient, outpatient, Part A, Part B, adjustments, rejections, etc.).
  • Ensure compliance with CMS testing standards and audit documentation.
  • Track and report test results, defects, and quality metrics in TestRail and JIRA (or equivalent defect tracking tool).
  • Participate in defect triage meetings and root cause analysis.

Qualifications

Required Skills & Experience

  • 2 years with BS/BA, 6 years no degree.
  • Proficiency in mainframe environments, including JCL, COBOL (reading and debugging), DB2 SQL queries, and VSAM file handling.
  • Proven experience with test case management and orchestration tools including Quick Test Pro, Open Text Unified Functional Testing (UFT), and TestRail, to design, execute maintain automated test cases.
  • Familiarity with Medicare claims processing, including 837/835 EDI transactions, claim adjudication logic, andCMS compliancerequirements.
  • Experience using defect tracking toolssuch asJira, or equivalent platforms to manage defects and testing workflow.
  • Solid understanding of Agile and Hybrid Agile/Waterfall testing methodologies, with the ability to adapt test strategies to evolving delivery models.
  • Ability to interpret and analyze business and system requirements, translating them into detailed and reusable test cases and automation scripts.
  • Strong attention to detail, with disciplined documentation practices to supportaudit and regulatory compliancestandards.
  • US Citizen and have the ability to obtain a Public Trust clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with automated testing frameworks for mainframe (e.g., CA Verify, Compuware Test Automation, REXX scripting).
  • Knowledge of CMS regulatory changes (e.g., ICD-10, HIPAA, DMEPOS).
  • Prior experience in healthcare payer systems or CMS audit environments.
  • Familiarity with DevOps pipelines and CI/CD integration with test management software.

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. LEUKAEMIA CARE TRUSTEE - REMOTE

UNPAID - VOLUNTEER

- Clinical

As part of the Board, you will be responsible for the organisation’s governance, strategic direction and sustainability alongside a highly committed and welcoming team. Your commitment will extend to:

  • Board of Trustees meetings (four per year*).
  • In-person attendance at the charity’s AGM (full day).
  • Contribute to the work of Sub-committee (around three per year).
  • Ad hoc availability as matters arise (by telephone/teleconference).
  • Attendance at key Leukaemia Care events.
  • Commit to the Board of Trustees for at least four years.

*Board meetings take place in hybrid form. Trustees can claim reasonable expenses, including help with travel and childcare.

Leukaemia Care is the UK’s leading leukaemia charity. For over 50 years, we have been dedicated to ensuring that everyone affected by leukaemia and associated conditions receives the best possible diagnosis, information, advice, treatment, and support.

In 2024, our support services were accessed more than 60,000 times.

  • Over £100,000 was paid out to those in need via our Cost of Living fund.
  • Over 600 people were supported by Leukaemia Care navigators in hospitals across the country.
  • Our Advice Service was accessed over 2,000 times.

“You fear the worst when you’re diagnosed with cancer, but Leukaemia Care provides compassion, help and support for those in need.”

Leukaemia Care’s Board of Trustees works to ensure that the charity is able to fully deliver on its purpose and mission. The Trustees are responsible for the effective and legal governance of the organisation, making sure that the charity is carrying out the purposes for which it was established, and is working for the public benefit and in line with the charity’s own governing documents.

The Board is currently looking for potential Trustees from across the UK who are able to bring knowledge and experience in the fields ofxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx

Qualities, skills and abilities for this role:

  • Good people and collaborative skills.
  • Able to commit enough time to the role.
  • Diplomacy and sensitivity.
  • Confidentiality.
  • Good independent judgment.
  • Ability to work effectively as a member of a team.
  • Integrity, openness, honesty.

There are a number of rules stipulated by the Charity Commission regarding the qualification of a person to act as a Trustee. Leukaemia Care will always undertake due diligence checks, (such as DBS) to ensure that all members of the Board meet these standards.

You don’t need to have been a Trustee before. What matters is your commitment to our values and your ability to think strategically, challenge constructively, and act in the best interests of the charity.

Description:

Teacher is an independent contractor responsible for instructing courses as offered by VSA at mutually determined times, as defined in the teacher contract. Teachers are the most important component in a learning environment; therefore, VSA hires only the most qualified professionals to teach in our setting.

Some Responsibilities:

  1. Teach within the bounds of the Veritas Statement of Faith.
  2. Operate within all parameters of the VSA Teacher Handbook.
  3. Teach classes at regularly scheduled times.
  4. Grade and return all assignments within 48 hours. Exception: Papers greater than two pages are to be returned no later than 10 days past the submission due date.
  5. Attend monthly teacher meetings.
  6. Demonstrate proficiency in the use of learning technologies (Learning Management System (LMS), online classroom).
  7. Communicate routinely with students’ families (primarily messaging in LMS), specifically regarding student performance and progress.
  8. Respond to families’ communications the same day when possible, and no later than two business days.
  9. Communicate with students a minimum of one week before classes begin to ensure course expectations are clearly conveyed.
  10. Communicate with students as needed outside of scheduled class hours to support and answer questions.
  11. Complete quarterly comments to keep students and families well informed of students’ progress.
  12. Ensure final grades are assigned and available for viewing by the close of the school year.
  13. Assist administration in making placement determinations based upon students’ competency levels.
  14. Maintain close contact with parents when students show signs of struggling in a course. Be prepared to offer well-considered, insightful solutions for struggling learners.

Skills and Qualifications:

  1. Conversant with and supportive of the reformed faith and classical Christian education according to the VSA Statement of Faith and Philosophy
  2. Understanding one’s discipline with a strong biblical worldview
  3. Ever-increasing familiarity with and appreciation for VSA curriculum
  4. Skilled in effective communication via messaging and phone
  5. Energized by interactions with students and families
  6. Loves children, particularly the ages being taught
  7. Has a servant’s heart and is relationship-minded
  8. Works diligently day to day under direct and indirect supervision
  9. Operates with a high level of professionalism, continually pursuing excellence

Physical Demands:

  1. Standing, walking and sitting for long periods of time
  2. Extensive typing on QWERTY style keyboard
  3. Extensive viewing of lighted computer monitor
  4. Speaking and hearing
  5. Reaching and bending
  6. Lifting up to 25 lbs
  7. Using hands to perform tasks
  8. Working in standard office conditions with and near electronics

Education:

  1. A Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university
  2. An advanced degree is desirable.

The Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) team delivers complex, multi-year infrastructure programmes across multiple regions, bringing together expertise in engineering, construction, sourcing, project controls, and delivery.
