raw.description:
IT Senior Architect – Windows Server & Infrastructure

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced IT Architect – Windows Server & Infrastructure to join our global Digital organization.

This role is responsible for defining, governing and evolving the enterprise architecture for Microsoft server platforms and core infrastructure services. The architect owns the technology roadmap, architecture standards and design principles for Windows-based infrastructure across on-premises datacenters.

The IT operations are outsourced to an external service provider. Therefore, this role is primarily architecture- and governance-focused rather than operational, with a strong emphasis on collaborating with and steering the managed service partner to ensure architectural standards, security requirements, cost optimizations and strategic objectives are effectively implemented.

The architect acts as the technical authority for Windows Server and infrastructure-related technologies, translating business requirements into scalable, resilient and secure technology solutions while supporting the organization's digital transformation and hybrid cloud strategy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the enterprise architecture for Windows Server and infrastructure platforms.

  • Define and maintain technology roadmaps for server, identity, virtualization, backup and datacenter infrastructure services.

  • Develop architecture standards, reference designs and governance guidelines.

  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend modernization opportunities.

  • Drive infrastructure standardization, consolidation and simplification initiatives.

  • Ensure alignment between infrastructure architecture, cybersecurity requirements and enterprise architecture principles.

  • Define architecture and technical standards for:

    • Microsoft Windows Server platforms

    • Identity Federation and Single Sign-On (SSO)

    • DNS and DHCP services

    • Microsoft SQL Server infrastructure

    • Backup (Veeam) and Disaster Recovery solutions

    • File and Print Services

    • Virtualization platforms (VxRail hypervisor)

    • Datacenter hosting infrastructure

    • Infrastructure monitoring and management platforms

  • Review and approve infrastructure solution designs.

  • Act as design authority for strategic projects and infrastructure changes.

  • Ensure outsourced services comply with architecture standards and best practices.

  • Manage technical escalations and architectural risks.

  • Participate in architecture review boards and governance forums.

  • Support critical incident and problem management activities when architectural expertise is required.

  • Maintain architecture documentation, standards and technical decision records.

  • Create and maintain technical reference architectures and implementation guidelines.

  • Identify cost optimization opportunities and technical debt reduction initiatives.

  • Drive continuous improvement and operational excellence across infrastructure services.

Required Experience and Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in infrastructure architecture, enterprise architecture, or senior infrastructure engineering roles.

  • Experience designing and operating enterprise-scale hybrid infrastructure environments.

  • Experience working in global organizations with complex IT landscapes.

  • Experience managing and governing outsourced infrastructure services.

  • Proven track record delivering infrastructure transformation and modernization initiatives.

  • Strong knowledge of Hybrid Cloud Architecture, Infrastructure Security and Hardening

  • Solid understanding of Virtualization Technologies (VxRail hypervisor / VMware)

  • Strong knowledge in Automation and Scripting (e.g. PowerShell) and High Availability and Fault-Tolerant Design Principles

  • Familiarity with ITIL processes and enterprise architecture frameworks (e.g. TOGAF)

  • Strategic thinker with a strong ownership mindset.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

  • Ability to balance business requirements, risk, cost and technology considerations.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Results-oriented with a focus on quality and continuous improvement.

  • Clear communicator, able to translate technical solutions for non-technical stakeholders.

  • Documentation lover, enjoys writing documents to share knowledge and support others.

  • Fluent in English (business level)

We Offer

Freedom with responsibility is the framework for HBK’s employees. This allows for a good balance between work and family life and for constant development of professional and personal skills in an international and enjoyable working environment.

One company – HBK

On 1 January 2019, Brüel & Kjær and HBM merged their activities into a new company called HBK (Hottinger Brüel & Kjær). With more than 3,500 employees worldwide and production facilities in Denmark, Germany, Austria, UK, USA, China and Portugal and presence in 80 countries, HBK is a leading player in the test and measurement area. raw.description:
About The Role

Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have insights, market predictions and best practices for a broad range of world-leading organizations. A Senior Director serves as a leader within Gartner’s Business and Technology Insights (BTI) group, establishing oneself as a credible voice within their designated market at local, regional and global levels. Utilizing exceptional research and analytical skills, a Senior Director plays a significant role in producing pragmatic and provocative insights which Gartner clients consume and apply to propel their business toward key objectives. They are a trusted source of advice for clients, reinforcing Gartner’s value every day by engaging them via in-person meetings, virtual meetings, sales support visits and Gartner conferences to discuss complex client challenges and offer appropriate recommendations.

You are primarily responsible for leading, and advising Gartner clients by researching Emerging Technology and Trends (ETT) within cybersecurity markets; specifically the AI data security and AI ecosystem data management market. You will be charged with creating and delivering both strategic and tactical advice and research content which guides Technology CEOs, Product and Innovation Leaders, Product Managers, and Marketing professionals on critical future security technologies and trends through written research reports, presentations, teleconference inquiries, and briefings. You will mentor and guide your research and elaborate on the evolution and impacts of those emerging technologies in the security market. During a research project, you will work closely with adjacent covering analysts, case-based researchers, and service delivery associates across Gartner, to deliver a world-class experience for our technology provider membership subscriptions.

Please note this is an individual contributor role NOT a leadership role with direct reports.

What You Will Do

  • Primarily, develop thought-leading advice on the emergence, adoption and disruptions that emerging technologies bring to bear on the AI data security and AI ecosystem data management across the world.

  • Work with Gartner clients and their teams while reflecting the research in meeting conversations, and as a speaker, either face-to-face, or via videoconference.

  • Grow the ETT team’s network of thought leaders (academics, investors, etc.), startups, and vendors that the research team can draw on for interviews, case-based research and emergent disruptive security technologies and trends.

  • Provide tailored inquiries and briefings for Gartner clients on Emerging Technologies in the Security Markets; specifically AI data security and AI ecosystem data management.

  • Ensure integrity of research & analysis of the team.

What You Will Need

  • Bachelor's degree; Graduate degree preferred or equivalent experience in cybersecurity field with specific relevance to AI data security and AI ecosystem data management

  • A minimum of 12 years of relevant experience

  • Subject Matter Expertise: Must be familiar with the AI data security and AI ecosystem data management market as well as typical service offerings, best practices, commonly used technologies, and vendors for client engagements and for research related to:

    • Cloud and on-premises data visibility, classification, monitoring and protection

    • Data management for AI model training, management, learning and governance

    • Data security for data at rest, in-flight, and use – encryption, tokenization

    • AI security platform architecture as it relates to data management

  • Experience with (or able to quickly learn) tools and data sources such as Pitchbook, CapIQ, TechCrunch, Bloomberg, and other forecast/financial data

  • Demonstrate executive presence; can immediately establish credibility with executives and additional stakeholders

  • Strong organizational skills; ability to work under tight deadlines and produce high quality deliverables

  • Demonstrate excellence in research and writing ability

  • Strong written and verbal proficiency, analytical and presentation skills; ability to engage clients and respond effectively to questions

  • Proficient in analyzing and synthesizing data; can effectively apply patterns and frameworks while drawing and defending conclusions to client challenges

  • Strong communication skills - able to explain complex concepts concisely and simply

  • Subject matter expertise; comfortable presenting at large and small-scale speaking engagements

  • Strong business and financial acumen

  • Deep knowledge of the global and competitive landscape within subject area as well as the interplay in that market

  • Ability to work independently, while also being intrinsically motivated to collaborate across teams and support the workflow of others, in a multicultural global team

  • Learning agile and adept with navigating highly matrixed environments

  • Ability to represent Gartner's research methodology and strategies effectively at all levels

  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% (where applicable)

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

raw.description:
Hydrosat is a space and data analytics company building a new Earth observation constellation and software platform to unlock the power of thermal infrared imagery. We deliver high-resolution thermal insights that help governments, defense agencies, and agribusinesses better manage water resources, agricultural production, national security threats, and critical infrastructure.

We grow through two distinct routes to market – government programmes, and commercial data and subscription products – and our Operations team keeps the business running behind both, giving executive leadership a clear, trusted view of how the company is performing.

We are looking for an Operations Analyst to join our Operations team and work closely with our Chief of Corporate Operations. You will help plan, coordinate, and build financial and operational models. You will also help support analysis and strategy proposals that inform how Hydrosat runs its business – from employee compensation and departmental planning, to ESG, ERM, and other org-wide efforts. You will support organization of the efficiency metrics that tell leadership where the company stands, as well as the implementation processes that result. Using Excel, PowerPoint, AI, and other tools of the trade you will turn complex, cross-functional data and workflows into clear analysis and presentation decks that senior leadership and department heads can act on, and will help with coordination and implementation across departments for such programs.

This is not a narrow reporting role. We expect our Senior Operations Analyst to be a genuine thought partner to the CCO and executive leadership – helping structure how the company thinks about its own performance, not just producing the numbers. The ideal candidate is as comfortable, for example, building a compensation model from scratch as they are distilling it into a clear, well-organized narrative for a monthly business review.

Responsibilities may include but are not limited to

  • Act as a flexible operations resource to the CCO, picking up cross-functional analysis, coordination, and projects as priorities shift

  • Build clear, well-structured Excel models and PowerPoint presentations that make complex operational and financial topics easy for leadership to act on

  • Prepare and help coordinate and run monthly revenue reviews, business reviews, and other leadership initiatives with the CCO, department leads and executive leadership

  • Partner closely with the CCO and executive leadership on corporate operations, business planning, and company financial topics

  • Build and maintain models and plans which may range from ERM, to ESG, OKRs, KPIs, supporting benchmarking, budgeting, and compensation planning decisions, among other key areas of org infrastructure

Career-defining. Life-changing.

At iRhythm, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills and your career while impacting the lives of people around the world. iRhythm is shaping a future where everyone, everywhere can access the best possible cardiac health solutions. Every day, we collaborate, create, and constantly reimagine what’s possible. We think big and move fast, driven by our commitment to put patients first and improve lives. We need builders like you. Curious and innovative problem solvers looking for the chance to meaningfully shape the future of cardiac health, our company, and your career

About This Role:

About iRhythm

iRhythm is a leading digital healthcare company transforming the way cardiac arrhythmias are clinically diagnosed by combining wearable biosensing technology with powerful cloud-based data analytics and machine-learning capabilities. Our goal is to be the leading provider of first-line ambulatory ECG monitoring for patients at risk for arrhythmias and to create better, more connected experiences for patients, healthcare providers, and customers.

About This Role

The Senior Director, Customer Care is responsible for the strategy, leadership, transformation, and performance of iRhythm’s Customer Care function, supporting patients, healthcare providers, accounts, Field Sales, and other key stakeholders.

Reporting to the Executive Vice President, Business Operations, this leader will set the strategic direction for Customer Care while ensuring strong performance across a complex, high-volume service environment. The Senior Director will define and execute a multi-year roadmap that evolves the operating model across customer experience, people, process, technology, digital channels, AI and automation, analytics, and organizational capabilities.

This leader will balance operational excellence today with transformation for the future; building a scalable, digitally enabled organization that delivers exceptional customer and patient experiences and measurable business value.

What You’ll Be Doing

Lead Customer Care Contact Center Strategy & Operations

  • Define and execute the Customer Care strategy and operating model, aligned with company growth, Operations priorities, and customer and patient experience objectives.
  • Provide overall leadership and accountability for service, quality, productivity, compliance, customer experience, cost, and operational risk.
  • Translate business priorities and changing demand into operating plans, workforce and capacity strategies, resource requirements, and organizational capabilities.
  • Anticipate emerging customer and business needs and evolve the Customer Care model to support growth, new products and services, and long-term scalability.

Elevate the Customer & Patient Experience

  • Establish a customer- and patient-centered service strategy that delivers consistent, high-quality experiences across the customer journey.
  • Lead the evolution of an omnichannel experience across voice, digital, messaging, and self-service, creating seamless transitions between automated and human-assisted service.
  • Develop digital and self-service strategies that simplify interactions, expand customer choice, improve resolution, and reduce avoidable contacts.
  • Leverage customer feedback, journey insights, contact drivers, and operational data to identify friction, address root causes, and influence improvements across products, processes, policies, and technology.

Shape the Future of Customer Care Contact Center

  • Define and execute a multi-year transformation roadmap spanning operating model, customer experience, digital channels, AI and automation, technology, workforce capabilities, and organizational design.
  • Serve as the business leader for Customer Care technology and digital enablement, defining future-state capabilities and sequenced investment priorities.
  • Evaluate emerging technology, AI, and automation capabilities and identify high-value applications across self-service, agent enablement, knowledge, routing, workflow, analytics, and quality.
  • Design the appropriate balance of digital, AI-enabled, and human-assisted service to improve customer experience, employee effectiveness, scalability, quality, and cost-to-serve.
  • Develop business cases and success measures for major transformation investments and ensure delivery of measurable customer, operational, workforce, and financial outcomes.
  • Drive adoption of new capabilities through process and workflow redesign, organizational readiness, capability building, and responsible AI practices appropriate for a regulated healthcare environment.

Drive Operational Excellence & Insights

  • Establish a disciplined operating cadence and performance framework across service, quality, customer experience, productivity, capacity, cost, and operational risk.
  • Leverage analytics and customer insights to understand demand, identify trends and root causes, and prioritize improvement opportunities.
  • Lead high-impact initiatives that improve processes, systems, productivity, scalability, quality, and service delivery.
  • Translate operational and customer data into clear executive-level insights, risks, priorities, and recommendations while fostering a culture of continuous improvement and data-driven decision-making.

Build, Lead & Influence

  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing Customer Care leadership team and organization with clear accountability for results.
  • Build the organizational structure, talent, skills, and leadership capabilities required to support an increasingly digital and AI-enabled Customer Care model.
  • Lead effectively through growth, transformation, technology implementation, and organizational change while fostering a culture of customer focus, accountability, innovation, and continuous learning.
  • Serve as the senior functional leader for Customer Care, partnering across Operations, Commercial, Product, Technology, Engineering, Quality, Regulatory, Compliance, and other functions to solve complex challenges and influence enterprise priorities.
  • Bring the voice of the customer into broader business, product, process, and technology decisions and represent Customer Care with strategic customers, partners, and external stakeholders as appropriate.

Required Qualifications

  • 15+ years of progressive experience in Customer Care, Contact Center Operations, Customer Experience, Customer Operations, or related service organizations, with significant senior leadership accountability for complex, high-volume operations through multiple levels of management.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Demonstrated success defining and executing functional strategy while delivering strong operational performance.
  • Proven ability to develop and execute multi-year transformation roadmaps spanning operating model, customer experience, digital capabilities, technology, workforce strategy, and organizational design.
  • Significant experience leading operational transformation, technology modernization, omnichannel service delivery, process improvement, and organizational change.
  • Strong understanding of modern Customer Care technologies and capabilities, including CRM, contact center platforms, workforce and quality management, knowledge management, analytics, digital channels, and self-service.
  • Strong AI and digital fluency, with the ability to evaluate emerging capabilities, identify high-value use cases, assess trade-offs and risks, and translate investments into measurable business outcomes.
  • Strong business and analytical acumen, including experience developing business cases and translating complex operational and customer data into executive-level insights and recommendations.
  • Proven ability to build high-performing leadership teams, influence across functions, and lead organizations through significant growth and change.
  • Experience managing strategic partners, third-party service providers, and/or global service delivery operations.
  • Exceptional executive communication, judgment, influencing, decision-making, and problem-solving capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience within healthcare, medical technology, healthcare technology, or another highly regulated industry.
  • Experience implementing AI, automation, intelligent self-service, agent-assist, or other AI-enabled Customer Care capabilities.
  • Experience leading large-scale contact center technology transformation, platform modernization, or digital enablement initiatives.
  • Experience with Salesforce, NICE, or comparable CRM and contact center technologies.
  • Advanced degree in Business, Operations, Healthcare Administration, Technology, or a related field.

The application window is expected to close on: 08/25/2026

Job posting may be removed earlier if the position is filled or if a sufficient number of applications are received.

Meet the Team

Cisco and Splunk are building a safer, more resilient digital world. Organizations around the globe rely on our security and observability platform to keep their systems secure, available, and performing at their best. The Analytics and Search organization powers one of the most important capabilities of the Splunk Platform. Our teams build the technology that helps customers explore, understand, and act on massive amounts of machine data. As AI becomes an increasingly important part of the platform, we continue to evolve our search technologies to support new ways of discovering insights and solving problems.

The Customer Problem Management team acts as a central hub that bridges technical and business stakeholders to drive accurate root cause analysis and ensure accountability for corrective actions. By partnering across departments, the team connects operational insights to product improvements and translates complex technical data into clear, impactful communications for customers and leadership.

Your Impact

As a Senior Problem Manager, you will transform customer-impacting incidents into actionable improvements and clear communications, ensuring systemic risks are mitigated before they recur. You will govern the post-incident lifecycle by partnering with global stakeholders to drive accountability and high-quality outcomes across the organization. Additionally, you will play a pivotal role in maturing our Problem Management practice by identifying emerging patterns through proactive data analysis to prevent future service failures. You will also take the lead on establishing next-generation capabilities, including end-to-end record linkage and executive reporting.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree plus 8+ years of experience in Problem Management, Incident Management, service operations, reliability, technical support, customer experience, or related operational discipline.

  • Experience with Problem Management concepts and practices, including post-incident review, root-cause analysis, contributing-factor analysis, corrective-action management, known errors, and continual improvement.

  • Experience with the end-to-end relationship among incidents, problems, root causes, known errors, engineering defects, corrective actions, permanent fixes, and customer outcomes.

  • Experience identifying recurring incidents and systemic patterns across multiple records, customers, products, services, or technical components.

  • Experience designing or substantially improving Problem Management capabilities, governance models, operational programs, or cross-functional workflows.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence resource allocation, establish accountability, sustain cross-functional stakeholder commitment, remove blockers, manage competing priorities, and drive work from investigation through permanent resolution.

  • Demonstrated ability to build reporting and executive-level narratives that connect operational status and technical findings to business risk, service performance, and customer experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • ITIL 4 or ITIL Version 5 certification, particularly training or certification related to Problem Management, or a comparable service-management qualification.

  • Experience leading complex Problem Management or post-incident programs in a large-scale cloud, SaaS, enterprise software, or technology-services environment.

  • Experience governing complex work across Engineering, Product, Operations, Support, and customer-facing organizations in a matrixed environment.

  • Demonstrated success operating as a senior individual contributor, leading complex cross-functional initiatives through influence rather than direct authority.

  • Experience establishing or modernizing a known-error management process, known-error repository, or Known Error Database.

  • Experience building a repeat-issue detection, trend-analysis, or problem-identification program.

  • Experience creating executive dashboards, leadership reporting, and governance cadences for Problem Management, service reliability, incident reduction, or corrective-action programs.

  • Familiarity with integrating or correlating information across incident-management, problem-management, defect-management, customer-support, and analytics platforms.

  • Experience building a Problem Management function or major practice area from an early stage to a defined, measurable, and sustainable operating model.

  • Experience with customer-facing root-cause communications and the review of sensitive technical content.

  • Familiarity with incident and work-management platforms such as incident.io, Jira, Salesforce, or comparable systems.

  • Experience developing training, operating procedures, governance frameworks, and continual-improvement programs.

  • Strong analytical and data-literacy skills, including the ability to define meaningful metrics, identify data-quality gaps, interpret trends, and turn findings into recommendations.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex technical findings into clear, accurate, and customer-appropriate language.

  • Experience influencing senior Product, Engineering, Operations, Support, and Customer Experience leaders in a complex, matrixed organization.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively and drive alignment across AMER, EMEA, and APJC time zones.

  • Ability to work on call as needed.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Please see the Cisco careers site to discover more benefits and perks. Employees may be eligible to receive grants of Cisco restricted stock units, which vest following continued employment with Cisco for defined periods of time.

U.S. employees are eligible for paid time away as described below, subject to Cisco’s policies:

  • 10 paid holidays per full calendar year, plus 1 floating holiday for non-exempt employees

  • 1 paid day off for employee’s birthday, paid year-end holiday shutdown, and 4 paid days off for personal wellness determined by Cisco

  • Non-exempt employees** receive 16 days of paid vacation time per full calendar year, accrued at rate of 4.92 hours per pay period for full-time employees

  • Exempt employees participate in Cisco’s flexible vacation time off program, which has no defined limit on how much vacation time eligible employees may use (subject to availability and some business limitations)

  • Additional paid time away may be requested to deal with critical or emergency issues for family members

For non-sales roles, employees are also eligible to earn annual bonuses subject to Cisco’s policies.

For non-quota-based sales performance elements such as strategic sales objectives, Cisco may pay 0% up to 125% of target. Cisco sales plans do not have a minimum threshold of performance for sales incentive compensation to be paid.

Job Description Summary

The Enterprise Sales Leader for Imaging Digital Solutions (IDS) is a highly visible, executive-facing sales role driving national strategy, growth, and execution across one of GE HealthCare’s fastest-growing portfolios: our Imaging Digital Solutions suite of software and professional services built to drive efficiency across radiology and imaging departments, including Imaging 360 and DoseWatch.


This role owns commercial execution and drives value through Imaging 360 in enterprise partnerships, serving as a trusted advisor to C-suite and radiology leadership as part of GE HealthCare’s Enterprise Care Alliance strategy. The ideal candidate brings strong SaaS acumen, fluency in healthcare trends and the IDN and health-system buying landscape, and the executive presence to articulate the clinical, operational, and financial value of our digital solutions to C-suite stakeholders at the country’s largest health systems.


This is an opportunity for a strategic commercial professional to shape enterprise digital transformation nationally, while expanding GE HealthCare’s Imaging Digital Solutions business.

Job Description

The Enterprise Sales Leader for Imaging Digital Solutions (IDS) is a senior individual contributor who drives and designs standalone and multi-product enterprise SaaS deal strategy across the largest, most strategic accounts in the country. This role owns commercial growth for the IDS portfolio at the enterprise level, partnering internally and externally to align account strategy, executive relationships, and long-term outcomes.

This role partners closely with Regional Modality Leaders when sizable, multi-SKU, multi-million-dollar, multi-year opportunities emerge-leading executive-level discovery, laddering IDS value to the broader enterprise partnership, and leading matrixed internal (Regional Modality Leaders, Product Management, Customer Success, Delivery, Finance, Legal) and external (health system executives, radiology leadership, procurement, IT) teams to scope, negotiate, and close agreements. Outside of these joint pursuits, this role independently drives stand-alone enterprise digital strategy and execution nationwide, in partnership with regional sales specialists and market account teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and deliver orders and sales commitments for enterprise-level Imaging Digital Solutions opportunities nationally

  • Develop and execute account strategy for standalone and multi-product/multi-SKU SaaS opportunities, partnering with Regional Modality Leaders on sizable, multi-million-dollar, multi-year deals

  • Enable and drive action plans in partnership with key market and account sales team members, ensuring aligned business planning and coordinated execution across the national territory

  • Partner with other digital and imaging business leaders to assemble enterprise value offerings and package designs that ladder multiple products into transformative, outcomes-based solutions for health systems

  • Build trusted C-suite relationships and lead executive-level discovery that ladders IDS value to the broader enterprise partnership and Enterprise Care Alliance strategy

  • Drive forecasting accuracy, business planning, and operating plan attainment across the enterprise pipeline

  • Consistently achieve or exceed quota across multi-year enterprise agreements

  • Prioritize strategically across a national portfolio of opportunities,leveragingand enabling internal resources to strengthen commercial execution

  • Lead matrixed internal teams (Regional Modality Leaders, Imaging Account Managers, Customer Success, Product Management, Delivery, Finance, Legal) and external stakeholders to scope, negotiate, and close large, strategic partnerships seamlessly

  • Serve as the enterprise-facing subject matter expert on Imaging Digital Solutions, educating internal teams and external stakeholders on value propositions, positioning, SaaS lifecycle execution, and expected outcomes

  • Maintain deep understanding of market dynamics, competitive landscape, and health system strategic priorities; provide structured feedback to Modality VP and Product Management on trends, wins, and losses

  • Apply data-driven, analytical thinking to guide pricing strategy and profitability

  • Navigate complex, multi-year sales cycles and organizational considerations with sound judgment and resilience

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degreeor higherfrom an accredited university or college or equivalent

  • Prior enterprise or strategic sales experiencerequired, minimum 7 years of experience

  • SaaS and subscription sales experience strongly preferred in the healthcare industry

  • Experience selling software, SaaS, or professional services into large Integrated Delivery Networks (IDNs) and other complex, multi-stakeholder health systems

  • Demonstrated executive presence and a consultative, insight-led selling style, witha track recordof building trusted C-suite relationships and managing large, multi-year, multi-stakeholder deal cycles

  • Proven ability to influence and align matrixed, cross-functional teams without formal authority,operatingwith patience, sound judgment, and resilience through long, ambiguous sales cycles

  • Ability to travel up to 50% of the time

About Pathway

Pathway is shaking the foundations of artificial intelligence by introducing the world’s first post-transformer model that adapts and thinks just like humans.

Pathway’s breakthrough architecture (BDH) outperforms Transformer and provides the enterprise with full visibility into how the model works. Combining the foundational model with the fastest data processing engine on the market, Pathway enables enterprises to move beyond incremental optimization and toward truly contextualized, experience-driven intelligence. The company is trusted by organizations such as NATO, La Poste, and Formula 1 racing teams.

Pathway is led by co-founder & CEO Zuzanna Stamirowska, a complexity scientist who created a team consisting of AI pioneers, including CTO Jan Chorowski who was the first person to apply Attention to speech and worked with Nobel laureate Goeff Hinton at Google Brain, as well as CSO Adrian Kosowski, a leading computer scientist and quantum physicist who obtained his PhD at the age of 20.

The company is backed by leading investors and advisors, including TQ Ventures and Lukasz Kaiser, co-author of the Transformer (“the T” in ChatGPT) and a key researcher behind OpenAI’s reasoning models. Pathway is headquartered in Palo Alto, California.

The opportunity

We are currently searching for a Machine Learning DevOps with experience in cloud and compute cluster management, scaling infrastructures, and Linux administration.

Our development, ML training, and production environment is in the cloud, using several major cloud providers. We need support in managing and automating the processes, and scaling the infrastructure to growing team and production needs.

You Will

  • Optimize infrastructure for ML training and inference (e.g., GPUs, distributed compute).
  • Automate and maintain ML/LLM pipelines (data ingestion, training, validation, deployment).
  • Manage model versioning, reproducibility, and traceability.
  • Work with terabyte-large datasets.
  • Implement ML-centric CI/CD practices.
  • Monitor model performance and data drift in production.

  • Series 7 & Series 63 licenses required
  • 2+ years of experience in a customer service or sales role preferred
  • Knowledge of tax exempt retirement products and services highly desirable
  • Previous phone center experience preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver exceptional customer results

The Purpose of Your Role

Retirement Planners play a critical role in driving customer loyalty so our Tax Exempt retirement plan participants choose to become Fidelity customers for life. They will be responsible for helping our workplace participants better understand and maximize their plan benefits and provide the education and guidance they need to make their own informed decisions.

The Skills You Bring

  • Your comprehensive understanding of the current market, economy, & economic trends
  • Your robust consultative, influencing and communication skills
  • Proven capability to be proactive and demonstrate initiative
  • Strong time management and prioritization skills
  • Your receptiveness to feedback and willingness to adapt to change

  • Track, record, and update incidents and service requests in the ticketing system, ensuring accurate and timely documentation.

  • Respond to common security threats such as spam, phishing, malware, and suspicious activity by following established runbooks and procedures.

  • Follow established playbooks, runbooks, and standard operating procedures, and help keep documentation current and accurate.

  • Communicate incident status clearly to teammates and, when directed, to clients.

  • Participate in shift coverage and an on-call rotation with teammates to maintain 24/7 operational SLAs.

Required Qualifications

  • Foundational understanding of networking, Windows, and cloud concepts such as SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with close attention to detail.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Willingness to work assigned shifts and participate in an on-call rotation.

  • U.S. citizenship and the ability to pass client background checks.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on exposure to Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 administration.

  • Familiarity with SIEM and security tooling such as Microsoft Sentinel and the Microsoft Defender suite.

  • Familiarity with monitoring and operations tooling such as Azure Monitor, Azure Automation, Azure Backup, and Azure Security Center.

  • Basic scripting exposure such as PowerShell or KQL.

  • Entry-level Microsoft certifications such as AZ-900, SC-900, or MS-900.

  • Experience working in a managed services or 24/7 operations environment.

Join a dedicated team supporting mission-critical operations for our clients. If you’re eager to launch your career in security and infrastructure operations and grow alongside experienced engineers, we encourage you to apply.

raw.title: Senior BI Engineer
raw.excerpt: Founded in 1981, Lanter Delivery Systems is a national logistics company and a leader in overnight, unattended delivery of auto, agricultural and industrial parts from their customer's distribution centers to dealer locations.
raw.description:
Founded in 1981, Lanter Delivery Systems is a national logistics company and a leader in overnight, unattended delivery of auto, agricultural and industrial parts from their customer's distribution centers to dealer locations. In the 21st century we live in a business culture that demands cost and logistical efficiencies combined with increased productivity. Lanter's strategic, process driven approach has been embraced by the marketplace and is setting new standards in the automotive and agricultural manufacturing marketplace. We see a bright future on the road before us and we are very excited about bringing our solutions to a variety of new industries.

The ideal candidate will embody our company's Non-Negotiables:

  • Walk in Humble Confidence- We are experts at what we do, but we never assume we know everything
  • Be Open, Honest and Respectful- We say what has to be said in a tactful, courteous way
  • Be Fearless- We never fail, we only learn
  • We are One Team- We achieve more together by collaboration and consensus
  • Delivery on Commitments- We do what we say we will do
  • We have a Passion to Serve- We are dedicated, hardworking individuals who provide exceptional service to our customers and to each other
  • We put Safety First- We prioritize the safety of our team members and customers above all else in our business
  • We Strive for Operational Excellence- We are dedicated to a culture of continuous improvements, driving quality and productivity

Position Summary:

As a Senior BI Engineer, you'll play a key role in strengthening Lanter's enterprise data capabilities by designing scalable data models that turn diverse source-system data into reliable, reusable information for analytics and reporting. A key focus of this role is solving complex data modeling challenges. This includes bringing together data from across customers, business units, industries, and operational systems to create models that account for varying business rules, exceptions, and data requirements. Your work will help support increasingly sophisticated use cases, including real-time visibility into routes, shipments, stops, and the freight or items associated with them.

Working within Lanter's Azure data environment, you'll also develop and support ETL/ELT pipelines, write advanced SQL queries, and enable reporting through BI tools. As a senior technical contributor, you'll be a go-to resource for complex BI and data modeling work, helping ensure solutions are scalable, reliable, and aligned with evolving business needs.

Essential Duties and Key Deliverables:

  • Design scalable enterprise data models that integrate complex data from multiple operational systems into consistent, reusable structures for analytics and reporting.
  • Translate business needs into data models and reporting-ready datasets that account for varying business rules, data quality, source-system complexities, and use cases such as real-time operational visibility.
  • Build, enhance, and support ETL/ELT processes within the Azure data environment.
  • Develop and optimize SQL queries, datasets, and BI reporting solutions that enable accurate, timely business analysis.
  • Partner with business and technical stakeholders to translate analytics and reporting needs into scalable data solutions.
  • Support data warehouse and BI initiatives tied to pharmaceutical requirements, the Descartes implementation, AI-related data needs, and other strategic priorities.

Required Experience and Skills:

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in business intelligence engineering, data engineering, analytics engineering, or a related data role.
  • Deep hands-on data modeling experience, including designing integrated enterprise and/or dimensional models, establishing entities and relationships, determining grain and business rules, and reconciling differing source-system requirements.
  • Advanced SQL and strong ETL/ELT experience working with data from multiple operational systems.
  • Hands-on experience with modern cloud-based data platforms and data lakes; experience with Databricks on Azure and Azure Data Lake is strongly preferred, with comparable cloud data platform experience considered transferable.
  • Experience translating complex or ambiguous business and reporting requirements into scalable, maintainable data solutions.
  • Experience developing or supporting BI and reporting solutions using Sigma, Power BI, or a comparable platform.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to independently own complex work.

Preferred Experience:

  • Experience in logistics, transportation, supply chain, or other environments with complex operational data.
  • Experience with Descartes or similar transportation/logistics technology platforms.
  • Experience supporting AI or advanced analytics data initiatives.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

This position has no direct supervisory responsibilities; however, the Senior BI Engineer is expected to provide technical guidance, review work, and serve as a go-to resource for complex BI engineering and data modeling needs.

Position Type:

This is a full-time, remote position, with a preference for candidates who can work from our St. Louis, Missouri headquarters.

Travel:

Travel may be required periodically for company meetings, training, or other business needs.

Work Environment:

This job is performed in a professional remote or office environment. The role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, and other job-related technology or systems. The team member may be required to sit for extended periods of time while working at a computer and communicating with internal and external business partners.

Physical Demands:

The team member is regularly required to listen, communicate verbally and in writing, sit for extended periods of time, use a computer and other office equipment, and occasionally lift up to 15 pounds at a time.

Other Duties:

This job description is not designed to cover a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the team member for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may vary by location based on business needs and may change at any time with or without notice.

EEO Statement:

Lanter Delivery Systems provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all team members and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Lanter Delivery Systems complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. Lanter Delivery Systems expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status. Improper interference with the ability of Lanter Delivery Systems team members to perform their job duties may result in discipline up to and including discharge.

Office Location:Remote within North Carolina.

POSTING DETAILS:

Make an Impact

Trillium Health Resources is a Tailored Plan and Managed Care Organization (MCO) serving 46 counties across North Carolina. We manage services for individuals with serious mental health needs, substance use disorders, traumatic brain injuries, and intellectual/development (IDD) disabilities. Our mission is to help individuals and families build strong foundations for healthy, fulfilling lives.

Why Work for Us?

Trillium believes that empowering others begins with supporting our team. We offer our employees:

  • A collaborative, mission-driven work environment
  • Competitive benefits and work-from-home options for most positions
  • Opportunities for professional growth in a diverse inclusive culture

Every day, our work changes lives – from children thriving through early intervention and school-based therapies, to adults with severe mental illness living independently and contributing to their communities.

If you are looking for a unique opportunity to make a tangible impact on the lives of others, apply today!

What We’re Looking For

Trillium Health Resources has a career opening for a Director, Clinical Operations - LTSS to join our team! The Director, Clinical Operations – LTSS leads major clinical operations functions, programs, or regional care management operations, setting strategic direction and ensuring effective delivery of integrated, whole-person care across the organization. The role is accountable for clinical and operational outcomes, provides clinical oversight and guidance across teams and managers, and drives continuous improvement in care delivery, compliance, and member outcomes.

On a typical day, you might:

  • Lead multiple clinical operations teams and/or functions, providing strategic direction, clinical oversight, and operational management.
  • Develop, implement, and evaluate clinical programs, policies, and procedures to support high-quality, integrated care delivery.
  • Direct staff including managers and supervisors, ensuring accountability for team performance, clinical quality, and operational outcomes.
  • Oversee clinical operations including care management, coordination, and utilization practices to ensure appropriate level of care and service delivery.
  • Monitor and evaluate program performance against clinical outcomes, accreditation requirements, and regulatory standards.

Employee Benefits:

Trillium knows that work/life balance is essential. That’s why we offer:

  • Typical working hours: 8:30 am – 5:00 pm; flexible work schedules available for some positions with management approval.
  • Work-from-home options available for most positions
  • Health Insurance with no premium for employee coverage
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • 24 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) plus 12 paid holidays in your first year
  • NC Local Government Retirement Pension (defined-benefit plan)
  • 401k with 5% employer match and immediate vesting
  • Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) qualifying employer
  • Quarterly stipend for remote work supplies

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in a health or human services field and three (3) years of progressive experience in care management, case management, or care coordination with MH/SU/DD populations, including experience in program development and/or program management.
  • Active North Carolina licensure as one of the following:
    • Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW)
    • Licensed Clinical Mental Health Counselor (LCMHC)
    • Licensed Psychological Associate (LPA)
    • Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT)
    • Licensed Clinical Addictions Specialist (LCAS)
    • Registered Nurse (RN)
  • Must have a valid driver’s license.
  • Must reside within North Carolina.
  • Must be able to travel within catchment as required.

Preferred:

  • Master’s degree in Social Work, Psychology, Nursing, Public Administration, Healthcare Administration, or related field.
  • Experience with the Long Term Service and Support services (LTSS) and Home and Community-Based Services (HCBS).

Deadline for Application: August 26, 2026 at 11:59 PM

How to Apply

To be considered, submit your application and resume through our ADP Career Center. Your resume must include:

  • Employer name, dates of service (month/year), average hours worked per week, and essential job duties
  • Education details (degree type, date awarded, institution, field of study)
  • Licensure/certification information, if applicable

After submission, your resume will be reviewed to ensure it meets the essential criteria for the position. You’ll be notified by HR regarding your application status as appropriate. All applicants will receive a final update once the recruitment cycle closes.

Join our Talent Community through ADP to stay informed about future opportunities. Be sure to keep your resume updated in your profile.

Trillium Health Resources is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer and a drug-free workplace. All candidates must pass a drug test as a condition of employment.

The Chief API Officer (CAPIO) is responsible for establishing and executing the organization's Application Programming Interface (API) strategy, governance, and ecosystem development initiatives. This executive leads API product management, developer experience, platform integration, Open Banking/Open Finance initiatives, API monetization, security, and digital ecosystem expansion. The role serves as the bridge between business strategy and technology innovation, ensuring APIs become strategic assets that drive revenue, partnerships, customer engagement, and digital transformation.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and execute the enterprise-wide API strategy aligned with business objectives.
  • Establish APIs as strategic products and revenue-generating assets.
  • Drive API-first and platform-centric business models across the organization.
  • Identify opportunities for ecosystem expansion through API enablement.
  • Advise executive leadership and the Board on API innovation and digital ecosystem trends.

API Product Management

  • Oversee the API lifecycle from design and development to deployment and retirement.
  • Define API product roadmaps and service portfolios.
  • Ensure APIs meet customer, developer, and partner requirements.
  • Drive adoption of API product management best practices.

Developer Ecosystem & Partnerships

  • Develop API onboarding programs and developer support initiatives.
  • Foster innovation through open APIs and third-party integrations.
  • Collaborate with external developers, fintechs, vendors, and strategic partners.

API Monetization & Commercial Strategy

  • Create new revenue streams through API products and services.
  • Identify commercial partnership opportunities leveraging APIs.
  • Monitor API usage, consumption trends, and profitability.
  • Support marketplace and ecosystem expansion strategies.

Open Banking & Open Finance Leadership

  • Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Drive innovation through financial data-sharing ecosystems.
  • Develop strategic API partnerships with financial institutions and fintech organizations.

Security, Risk & Compliance

  • Oversee authentication, authorization, and access management frameworks.

raw.description:
Bullhorn's core purpose is to create an incredible customer experience, and the organization has a sharp focus on delivering very high quality products and services to its customers. The company culture is shaped by five Core Values: Ownership, Energy, Speed & Agility, Service, and Being Human. Each value, and its underlying definition, serves as a behavioral guide for employees as they interact with customers and fellow coworkers and is an embedded way of operating across our organization.

Bullhorn is a fast-paced and dynamic environment where hard work and outstanding results are rewarded and celebrated. We value those that exhibit an eagerness to learn and a strong natural desire for continuous improvement and we encourage team members to stretch themselves, acknowledge challenges and learn from them. With a strong focus on growth, we provide ample opportunities for career development and prioritize promoting from within. We believe that leaders should care deeply about the development of their employees at all levels, emphasizing emotional intelligence and accountability. Our leaders collaborate closely to ensure the success of their teams, and we work together to achieve shared goals, creating a challenging and rewarding workplace for everyone.

About The Role

As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you will own product positioning and, in collaboration with other Bullhorn teams, develop go-to-market plans that drive growth and client retention. You will be looked at as a SME, leveraging this expertise in combination with strong business acumen to inform product and business strategy and enable key stakeholders.

A Typical Day Will Include...

  • Go-to-market ownership of Recruitment Cloud the global leading recruitment solution for staffing firms on the Salesforce platform

  • Leveraging your story-telling abilities to bring your product story to life through buyer-focused messaging, blog posts, customer/sales presentations, web content and other customer-facing content

  • Serving as a product SME by speaking to customers and Sales team to understand customer needs and requirements, and create solution content (e.g. customer presentation, sales enablement materials, product videos, website copy) to articulate our solution capabilities and value to both external and internal audiences

  • Educating both internal and external stakeholders about our product features and their benefits; speak and present internally and externally to promote our product story

  • Performing competitive analysis, developing powerful competitive positioning and enabling internal teams including Sales, Solution Consulting, Marketing, and Product

  • Partnering closely with Product to understand the product strategy and roadmap, providing input from knowledge of market, customers, and go-to-market activities

  • Working with the wider marketing organization to drive campaigns to build sales pipeline and hit bookings goals for the Bullhorn Platform, including webinars, digital marketing, account-based marketing and other programs

  • Driving adoption of new innovations with our existing client base to ensure they’re maximising their value with Bullhorn.

This job might be a fit if…

  • You have at least 5+ years business experience in Product Marketing, Product Management, or a similar function

  • You have a strong understanding of SaaS technology, including their business models, market dynamics, and pricing

  • You like to get your hands dirty, and are looking for a fast-paced business that’s growing fast

  • You have the ability to independently manage projects and expectations cross-functionally to deliver results

  • You have excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to and working with senior-level executives internally and externally

  • You possess strong commercial acumen and enjoy the challenge of supporting sales with complex deal cycles

  • You possess the ability to tell a captivating story using words, images, video; an understanding of how to create content that engages an audience

  • You are detail oriented and process-driven. You love data and rely on it to make decisions.

Nice to have

  • You have experience working with a CRM, reporting, analytics or Business Intelligence solution

  • You have experience in the recruitment/ staffing industry

  • You have experience working with solutions on the Salesforce platform

What we offer...

  • Group Critical Illness, Group Income Protection, Group Life Assurance, Pension, Vision, EAP
  • Access to our Discounts and Wellbeing Portal
  • Optional from DAY ONE - Private Medical Coverage & Ride to Work Scheme
  • Unlimited Vacation
  • Quarterly paid volunteer days
  • Lucrative Employee Referral Program (eligible for prior to your first day)
  • Career development opportunities up/across Bullhorn

We are a people-first culture where everyone’s contribution is valued and respected. We're looking for smart, forward-thinking individuals who aren't afraid to challenge the status quo and bring fresh perspectives to the table. If you're someone who thrives in a casual, yet fast-paced and agile environment, we'd love to have you join us.

  • Exceptional verbal and written English communication and presentation skills.

Job Overview

As a member of our Engineering Services Team, you will be responsible for creating substation drawing packages including one-line drawings, substation plan and elevation drawings, electrical assembly drawings, equipment manufacturing drawings, foundation and grounding plan drawings, conduit and cable routing plan drawings, cable schedules, bill of materials, and detailed electrical connection drawings.

A Day In The Life

Every day at Hubbell is different and you’ll contribute in many ways. On any given day, you’ll make a difference by:

Employing Lean manufacturing principles to all product fabrication activities in support of existing production and processes as well as new configuration of existing products.

Supporting and leading capital projects to improve safety, production efficiency, and quality.

Troubleshooting production problems and making recommendations based on thorough analysis.

Driving engineering-related manufacturing changes that improve quality, cost, lead time, etc.

Providing solutions to problems that adversely affect operator safety, quality, productivity, and cost.

Analyzing and evaluating manufacturing methods, equipment, and standards.

Creating 3D models and drawings using SolidWorks.

Reviewing drawings created by others for accuracy and consistency with company standards.

Reviewing customer specifications for comparison to company standards and capabilities.

Issuing Engineering Change Notices with supporting documentation in accordance with company standards.

Preparing final reports and conducting a quality check of all documents and reports, verifying accuracy of data, information, and calculations.

Taking a leadership role in process validation and pilot production activities for new and/or improved equipment and processes.

Investigating new technologies and options for equipment, design, and assembly.

What will help you thrive in this role?

Bachelor’s Degree in General Engineering, Computer Science, or related field (required)

3-6 years of experience in engineering with a focus on design, development, or project management (required)

Proficiency in relevant engineering software and tools required for design, analysis, and implementation (required)

Strives to develop methods to improve and promote quality; demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness.

Follows policies and procedures; completes administrative tasks correctly and on time; supports organization’s goals and values; benefits organization through outside activities; supports affirmative action and respects diversity.

Displays willingness to make decisions; exhibits sound and accurate judgment; supports and explains reasoning for decisions; includes appropriate people in decision-making process; makes timely decisions.

Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness; looks for ways to improve and promote quality; applies feedback to improve performance; monitors own work to ensure quality.

Hubbell Incorporated

Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently.

The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses.

We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe.

Hubbell Utility Solutions

Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications. HUS provides the critical components that allow the grid to reliably transmit and distribute energy, as well as the communications and controls technologies to make the grid smarter and more flexible.

raw.description:
Du hast Lust auf ein Praktikum, bei dem du dich für den Klimaschutz einsetzen kannst? Du willst gerne in das Fundraising einer gemeinnützigen Organisation reinschnuppern und hast Spaß an der Organisation und Durchführung von Veranstaltungen? Du hast 3 Monate Zeit? Super! Dann melde dich bei uns! Wir suchen insbesondere von Februar bis April eine:n Praktikant:in im Bereich Veranstaltungsorganisation für unser jährliches Frühlingsfest.

Mögliche Aufgaben:

  • Du unterstützt das Fundraising-Team in allen relevanten Aspekten der Veranstaltungsplanung, -durchführung und -nachbereitung.

  • Du übernimmst das Einladungsmanagement und kümmerst dich um die Kommunikation mit den eingeladenen Unterstützer:innen.

  • Du übernimmst Rechercheaufgaben zu relevanten Themen, z.B. eine passende Location oder spannenden Speaker:innen.

  • Du bereitest passende Texte für die Akquise von Catering, Speaker:innen, etc vor und übernimmst die Kommunikation.

  • Du bist kreativ und bereitest Grafiken (Einladungen, Programme, etc.) auf Canva für anstehende Veranstaltungen vor.

  • Du bist am Tag der Veranstaltung vor Ort und kümmerst dich um die von dir vorbereiteten Bereiche.

  • Du hast noch weitere Ideen, wie wir unsere Veranstaltungen für unsere Unterstützer:innen so spannend wie möglich machen können? Super, wir freuen uns über deinen Input!

  • Wenn du darüber hinaus Lust hast, in weitere Fundraising-Themen reinzuschnuppern, hast du dazu in unserem Team ebenfalls die Gelegenheit.

  • Du hast ein hohes Interesse an Event-Management und allen Phasen der Organisation und Durchführung von Veranstaltungen (digital und vor Ort).

  • Du bist sicher und schnell im Erstellen von Texten.

  • Du bist kommunikationsfreudig und gehst gerne auf Menschen zu.

  • Du hast erste Erfahrungen im Umgang mit Spender:innen gemacht oder bringst sehr viel Lust mit, dich in das Thema Fundraising einzuarbeiten.

  • Du bist ein:e Teamplayer:in und arbeitest selbstständig und strukturiert. Du erkennst kritische Grenzen, bei denen du nach Unterstützung oder Feedback fragst.

  • Dir liegt der Klimaschutz am Herzen und du hast richtig viel Lust, anderen Menschen das Thema näher zu bringen.

  • Du willst Menschen zeigen, wie wichtig das Engagement durch Spenden für gemeinnützige Organisationen ist.

Achtung: Das Praktikum ist nicht vergütet. Wir arbeiten daran, zukünftig Praktikant:innen zumindest eine Aufwandsentschädigung bezahlen zu können. Sobald das eine Option ist, werden wir diesen Text hier anpassen.

Remote-Arbeit ist möglich. Idealerweise suchen wir für diese Stelle eine Person, die in Berlin lebt oder sich vorstellen kann, regelmäßig nach Berlin zu kommen, da es sich vor allem um die Unterstützung bei einer Veranstaltung in vor Ort handelt.

Haben wir dich neugierig gemacht? Dann werde Zeronaut:in und arbeite gemeinsam mit uns am Ziel, das Pariser Klimaversprechen einzuhalten und Deutschland mit konkreten Lösungen klimaneutral zu machen. Wir - das ist ein gut gemischtes Team von Berufseinsteiger:innen und Berufserfahrenen, die sowohl aus NGOs und Start-ups, als auch aus Konzernen kommen. Was wir schätzen, sind Vielfalt und Offenheit, Professionalität, Tatkraft und Effizienz und vor allem den Antrieb, die Klimakrise nicht weiter eskalieren zu lassen. Denn was uns alle eint, ist der unbedingte Wille, unser Ziel zu erreichen.

Bitte sende uns einen Lebenslauf und ein Anschreiben zu, aus dem Deine Motivation deutlich wird.

GermanZero e.V. ist eine führende Klimaschutzorganisation, die sich einem großen Ziel verschrieben hat: Wir machen Deutschland bis 2035 klimaneutral. Wir sind an der Schnittstelle von Wissenschaft, Politik und Zivilgesellschaft tätig und setzen dabei auf innovative Strategien und dynamische Kollaboration, um nachhaltige Veränderungen zu bewirken. Mit konstruktiven Lösungsangeboten wollen wir die Umsetzung einer effektiven Klimapolitik vorantreiben.

Dafür arbeiten wir in drei Tätigkeitsfeldern, die zusammen den Fahrplan hin zu einem klimaneutralen Deutschland ergeben: Ein 1,5-Grad-Gesetzespaket, das alle gesetzlichen Lösungen auf Bundesebene enthält, Politikgespräche, die diese Lösungen in den politischen Diskurs bringen, und das Netzwerk LocalZero, dass schon 90 Lokalteams dabei unterstützt, Ort für Ort klimaneutral zu machen. Rund 1.000 Ehrenamtlichen bieten wir damit Beteiligungsformate, um selbst wirksam gegen die Klimakrise vorzugehen. GermanZero wurde 2019 als gemeinnütziger Verein gegründet, ist rein spendenfinanziert tätig und hat aktuell 30 hauptamtliche Mitarbeiter:innen sowie einen ehrenamtlich tätigen Vorstand.

raw.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

About the Role

You’ll design coding tasks that challenge frontier AI coding agents. Each task is a self-contained Docker environment with a broken piece of software; an AI agent attempts the fix; automated tests verify the outcome. Your deliverable is the full task package: broken code, tests, instructions, and a reference solution proving the task is solvable.

Responsibilities:

  • Invent a realistic developer scenario — a real bug, a broken ETL, a missing feature — not a toy problem.
  • Build a reproducible Docker environment with pinned dependencies.
  • Write a pytest that verifies outcomes, not specific commands — deterministic, non-flaky, and does not leak the fix.
  • Write an instruction.md that reads like a Jira ticket a developer would receive.
  • Write a reference solve.sh proving the task is solvable.
  • Calibrate difficulty so current state-of-the-art agents solve the task 20–60% of the time.
  • Iterate based on feedback from expert QA reviewers.
  • Later: review other authors’ tasks as a QA reviewer.

Not in scope

  • Data labeling, prompt engineering.
  • Production code to ship — you design problems and verification for AI agents.
  • Leetcode puzzles — scenarios must look like real developer work.
  • Not every candidate task ships — quality over quantity.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of production software development in one backend stack — Python, Go, Node.js, Java, or Rust. Depth in one stack beats breadth.
  • Python + pytest fluency — required regardless of primary stack. The task harness is pytest-based even when the broken app is in another language. Fixtures, parametrize, monkeypatch, timeouts, conftest.py.
  • Docker authoring — reproducible Dockerfiles, pinned dependencies, multi-stage builds when needed, non-root user.
  • Linux & Bash — comfort debugging inside containers (strace, lsof, journalctl); shell beyond set -euo pipefail.
  • AI coding agent experience — Claude Code, Cursor, Roo Code, or similar, on non-trivial work. You can cite a specific time the AI was confidently wrong and how you caught it.
  • English — B2+ written.

Not a fit

  • Data Science, ML, or Computer Vision engineers without backend-engineering output.
  • Manual QA testers without automation or test authoring.
  • Frontend-only, low-code / no-code, IT Support, or Business Analysts.
  • Engineers who have never written pytest from scratch.
  • Junior, intern, or assistant as the most recent role.

Preferred qualifications

  • Domain depth in Security, System Administration (nginx / systemd / cron), Scientific Computing (NumPy / PyTorch / SciPy), DevOps, or Git internals.
  • Modern Python tooling (uv, poetry, pyproject.toml).
  • Coverage tooling (pytest-cov, coverage.py, gcov, llvm-cov, kcov).
  • Fuzzing or property-based testing (Hypothesis).
  • Prior contribution to agent-evaluation benchmarks or related frameworks.

Process

Apply → Pass qualification (90-minute sample-task screen + short behavioral interview) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid.

Time commitment

  • Onboarding: ~10 hours per first task.
  • Steady state: ~5 hours per task, 2–4 parallel tasks per author.
  • Realistic weekly load: 8–20 hours. Higher volume available for top performers.
  • You choose when and how to contribute; tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet acceptance criteria.

Compensation:

  • Paid contributions, rates up to $35/hour*.
  • Task-based compensation equivalent to hourly rate, depending on performance and volume.
  • Some projects include incentive payments.

*Rates vary based on expertise, skills assessment, location, project needs, and other factors. Higher rates may be provided to highly specialized experts. Lower rates may apply during onboarding or non-core project phases. Payment details are shared per project.

Apply

Submit your CV via the Mindrift platform. Indicate your English level, note this role (Software Engineering Evaluation Specialist — Terminal Bench), and include a GitHub profile link if available.

We are looking for a creative and resourceful Senior Unity Technical Artist experienced working in a professional videogame development environment using Unity. They are a logical and systemic thinker with an iterative approach to development, someone with a collaborative spirit, excellent communication skills, and an enthusiasm for RPG and turn-based videogames. The ideal candidate enjoys working with talented artists, designers, writers, engineers, and management, with a drive to create a beautiful and immersive gameplay experience.

  • Familiar with technical artistry best practices, design patterns, and unit testing.

  • Enthusiastic for quality gameplay and familiar with the art styles of many games and genres, past and present.
  • Strong self-discipline, motivated, a self-starter with a drive for excellence.

  • Courteous and patient, able to work effectively with people across disciplines and personality types.
  • Adaptable: The job can change according to the needs at hand and requires wearing various hats.

  • Possesses strong written, visual, and verbal English language communication and presentation skills.

  • Experienced working with professional art tools (e.g. Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, 3ds Max, Blender, Adobe Substance Painter).
  • Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and Visio.

Bonus Points

The Company

Seismic Squirrel is a talented and passionate team of both industry veterans and enthusiastic newcomers. We share a strong desire to tell fascinating stories supporting engaging gameplay mechanics.

As Director of Corporate Development, you will lead strategic transactions, including mergers and acquisitions (M&A), investments, divestitures and partnerships. The ideal candidate will possess exceptional financial modeling skills, transaction experience, and the ability to collaborate across executive and functional teams to execute high-impact deals that support long-term enterprise growth.
